stories.title: Karachi Traffic Disrupted as Protests Cause Severe Road Closures
stories.summary:
Residents of Karachi encountered severe commuting difficulties on Thursday due to multiple road blockages and heavy traffic congestion caused by various protests across the city. The Karachi Traffic Police reported that the Superhighway near Al Asif Square was completely closed for inbound and outbound traffic, forcing authorities to implement alternative routes such as Punjab Adda, Total Pump, and Faria Chowk for travelers coming from Hyderabad. Similar closures were enforced on both sides of Hub River Road, where heavy traffic backed up and light vehicles were diverted through inner areas and the Northern Bypass.

Additional protests and road shutdowns affected other critical locations throughout the metropolitan area. Both roads linking Ghaghar Phatak near Sassi Toll Plaza on the National Highway were shut down, prompting traffic police to redirect light traffic from Thatta toward the FFC Factory Area, Steel Mill, and Steel Mill Chowrangi. Traffic flow was also severely slowed around Abu Al-Hasan Isfahani Road, Madras Chowk, Maskan Chowrangi, and Nipa due to the spillover effects from the Superhighway closures. Furthermore, protests temporarily closed down Sharea Faisal near the Baloch Colony flyover and Lucky Pahari on Hub River Road, though police confirmed that some locations later reopened and officers were deployed to manage the flow.

Karachi Traffic Police personnel maintained a visible presence at these various disruption sites to implement necessary diversions and assist commuters. Authorities advised drivers to utilize designated alternative routes to bypass the affected zones while ongoing measures were taken to restore regular traffic movement. The widespread disruptions highlighted significant logistical challenges for daily commuters navigating the city during the demonstrations.

Imtiaz Ali, a Karachi-based reporter with over 25 years of experience, covers crime, politics, courts, government affairs, and the health sector for Dawn.

stories.title: AJK Government Removes Rawalakot Mayor Over Anti-State Allegations
stories.summary:
The Azad Jammu and Kashmir government removed Rawalakot Mayor Abdul Naeem Khan from office on Thursday, simultaneously terminating his municipal corporation membership due to his alleged involvement in anti-state activities. According to a notification issued by the Local Government and Rural Development Department, the action was executed under Section 23(2) of the Local Government Act, 1990. A separate notification from the AJK Home Department, dated November 15, revealed that Khan’s name was placed on the Fourth Schedule under Section 16 of the AJK Anti-Terrorism Act, following a cabinet decision to target activists of the proscribed Joint Awami Action Committee.

Khan, an elected mayor since 2023 associated with the Jammu Kashmir Peoples Party, previously headed a faction of the Rawalakot traders’ body. The region has experienced months of tension and violence-marred protests, primarily driven by the JAAC's demand to abolish 12 refugee seats in the AJK Legislative Assembly. These demonstrations led to violent clashes between protesters and law enforcement, particularly in June and July. Consequently, the previous AJK government declared the JAAC a proscribed organization on June 5. While the AJK Legislative Assembly recently offered to resume negotiations with the committee subject to the surrender of armed groups and a commitment to constitutional methods, the government has continued taking strict administrative actions against affiliated entities.

In a related development, the AJK Elementary and Secondary Education Department canceled the registration of 14 private educational institutions across Poonch district, including areas in Rawalakot, Hajira, Jandali, and Thorar. Approved by the chairman of the AJK Private Educational Institutions Regulatory Authority under Rule 8(3) of the Rules of 2015, the decision stemmed from reports that these schools engaged in activities contrary to the integrity and solidarity of the state. This followed the earlier cancellation of registrations for 10 other private schools on similar grounds.

stories.title: Sri Lanka Defeats India by Eight Wickets in Rising Stars Asia Cup
stories.summary:
India was knocked out of the Rising Stars Asia Cup after suffering an eight-wicket defeat against Sri Lanka in the first semi-final match held in Doha. Batting first, India A set a target of 317 runs for the loss of eight wickets, driven by Abhishek Sharma's 78 runs and a half-century from Shahbaz Ahmed. Bowlers Shahbaz Ahmed and Harshit Rana each claimed one wicket for India, but their efforts were insufficient to alter the outcome of the match.

Sri Lanka A successfully chased down the 319-run target in 41.3 overs, losing only two wickets in the process to secure their place in the tournament final. Key batting performances for Sri Lanka included Pavan Rathnayake with 31 runs and Nishan Madushka, who contributed a half-century. Meanwhile, Sanath Jayawardena and Diyan Lasantha delivered outstanding innings, scoring 105 and 116 runs respectively.

With this victory, Sri Lanka A advances to the final match of the tournament. In the championship fixture, they are scheduled to face either Bangladesh A or the Pakistan Shaheens.

stories.title: India Presents Bid to IOC for Hosting the 2036 Olympic Games
stories.summary:
The Indian Olympic Association announced on Thursday that it presented a strong case for hosting the 2036 Olympic Games during a virtual presentation to the International Olympic Committee’s Future Host Commission. IOA chief executive Raghuram Iyer stated that the organisation is highly confident of advancing to the next stage of the bidding process. The proposed bid focuses on the western city of Ahmedabad, which is already set to host the 2030 Commonwealth Games and is bidding for the 2038 Asian Games.

To secure the event, India must compete against Germany, Qatar, Hungary, Turkey, South Africa, and South Korea while proving to the IOC that it can successfully manage an event of Olympic scale and complexity. Iyer noted that the bid receives complete backing from all stakeholders, including the central government, emphasizing that such a massive endeavor requires unified support across city, state, and union levels. Supporting infrastructure and venues being built for the 2030 Commonwealth Games in Ahmedabad are intended to serve the Olympics as well.

Selected candidate cities will advance to a strategic dialogue phase in March 2027, followed by a targeted dialogue stage, with the ultimate 2036 host announcement taking place after the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Although India previously hosted the 2010 Commonwealth Games in New Delhi—which faced corruption and mismanagement allegations that organizers denied—the nation is actively working to build its hosting credentials. However, challenges persist regarding the country's doping record and its athletes' relatively limited overall Olympic success.

stories.title: Hamas Weighs Response Following Israeli Airstrikes That Kill Ten in Gaza
stories.summary:
Hamas chief Khalil Al-Hayya stated on Thursday that the group can no longer withstand ongoing Israeli attacks, following strikes in Gaza that local medics reported killed at least 10 people. Among the fatalities was Khaled Abu Nada, a member of Hamas’s political office and the Hamas-appointed deputy minister of education, who died alongside his wife when an apartment in Deir Al-Balah was struck during the third consecutive night of air raids. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed the targeted killing, stating that approximately 80 Hamas militants have been eliminated over the past month and asserting that no Hamas leader is immune.

The recent escalation includes three additional airstrikes in Gaza City that killed seven individuals in the Tuffah neighborhood, Beach refugee camp, and Sheikh Radwan, alongside a reported fatal shooting in the Bureij refugee camp. The Israeli military stated that Abu Nada managed Hamas’s economic portfolio, banking networks, and funding for militant operations, arguing his death would diminish the group's financial and military capabilities. Conversely, Hamas condemned the killings of academics and civilian figures as heinous crimes and violations of international law and the Gaza ceasefire agreement.

Hamas placed political and moral responsibility for the ongoing violence on US President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace, accusing it of failing to halt attacks and encouraging further bloodshed. Hayya stated that Hamas would consult with other Palestinian factions to determine a response to daily killings and violations, noting that the group cannot accept the current equation of blockade and violence. According to respective Palestinian and Israeli tallies, at least 1,600 Palestinians and 5 Israeli soldiers have died since the October 2025 ceasefire, while Israel's broader military campaign since 2023 has resulted in over 74,000 Palestinian deaths, widespread hunger, and the displacement of Gaza's entire population.

stories.title: Makkah Pact Nations to Discuss Yemen Conflict in Islamabad
stories.summary:
Officials from the mutual defence agreement known as the Makkah pact are scheduled to gather in Islamabad to address the ongoing conflict between Saudi Arabia and Houthi fighters in Yemen, according to Pakistan's Defence Minister Khawaja Asif. The upcoming meeting will bring together foreign and defence ministers from Saudi Arabia, Turkiye, and Pakistan. These three nations originally signed the pact in August, committing to mutual military assistance if any of them face an attack. Riyadh has continuously encountered attacks from Yemen's Houthis, who target cities, maritime shipping, and oil facilities as the civil war's intensity grew.

Asif emphasized that under the terms of the agreement, any aggression directed at Saudi Arabia is considered an attack on both Pakistan and Turkiye. He commended the way Riyadh has managed the hostilities with the Houthis, who currently control large portions of Yemeni territory, including the capital city of Sanaa. The defence minister noted that the defensive alliance, born out of a broader regional conflict expansion following US-Israeli strikes on Iran in February, remains in a nascent phase and requires frequent discussions to establish a concrete framework over the coming months.

While declining to speculate on how the coalition would respond if Iran launched a direct assault on Saudi Arabia, Asif pointed to Israel as a potential source of regional aggression, highlighting the necessity for neighboring nations to unite. He also mentioned Pakistan's previous diplomatic efforts in brokering a temporary halt in fighting between Washington and Tehran, alongside a roadmap for reopening the Strait of Hormuz and addressing Iran's nuclear program. Although that truce ultimately collapsed, Doha and Islamabad have continued shuttle diplomacy to revive the ceasefire, with Asif describing the ongoing mediation outcomes as fragile and incomplete.

stories.title: بلاول بھٹو نے محسن نقوی کو محنتی وزیر قرار دے دیا
stories.summary:
پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی کے چیئرمین بلاول بھٹو زرداری نے ملتان میں میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وفاقی وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی کو سب سے محنتی وزیر قرار دیا اور کہا کہ وہ ان کے بڑے بھائی کی طرح ہیں جو اہم ذمے داریاں اٹھا رہے ہیں۔ انہوں نے بانی پی ٹی آئی کو ایک سیاسی قیدی قرار دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ پاکستان تحریک انصاف ایک سیاسی حقیقت ہے۔

بلاول بھٹو نے مولانا فضل الرحمان کی نظر بندی کی بھی سخت مذمت کی اور واضح کیا کہ ان کے بیانات کو متنازع بنانے کی کوشش کی جا رہی ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ وہ کسی پر تنقید نہیں کر رہے بلکہ صرف اپنا حق اور مؤقف پیش کر رہے ہیں اور ان کی آواز کو دبایا نہیں جا سکتا۔

دوسری جانب اسلام آباد میں مکہ دفاعی معاہدے کے تحت آج ایک اہم اسٹریٹجک سیاسی و دفاعی کمیٹی کا اجلاس طلب کیا گیا ہے۔ اس اجلاس میں پاکستان، ترکیہ اور سعودی عرب کے وزرائے خارجہ اور دفاع شرکت کریں گے جہاں یمن تنازع اور باہمی امور پر تفصیلی گفتگو کی جائے گی۔

علاوہ ازیں، ملک کے دیگر حصوں میں مختلف قانونی اور انتظامی امور بھی زیر بحث رہے۔ لاہور میں ایک نجی انسداد منشیات اسپتال سے ایک لڑکی کی لاش برآمد ہوئی جبکہ اسلام آباد کی سیشن عدالت میں فاطمہ اصغر قتل کیس کی سماعت ہوئی۔ ایف آئی اے نے کارروائی کرتے ہوئے ایک مشتبہ انسانی اسمگلر کو بھی حراست میں لے لیا۔

stories.title: اسلام آباد میں مکہ دفاعی معاہدے کی اسٹریٹجک کمیٹی کا اجلاس
stories.summary:
اسلام آباد میں آج مکہ دفاعی معاہدے کے تحت اسٹریٹجک سیاسی و دفاعی کمیٹی کا ایک اہم اجلاس منعقد ہو رہا ہے۔ اس اعلیٰ سطح کے اجلاس میں پاکستان، ترکیے اور سعودی عرب کے وزرائے خارجہ اور وزرائے دفاع شرکت کر رہے ہیں، جن کا مقصد خطے کی سلامتی اور یمن تنازع پر تبادلہ خیال کرنا ہے۔

وفاقی وزیر دفاع خواجہ آصف کا اس موقع پر کہنا ہے کہ خطے کو اسرائیلی جارحیت کا شدید خطرہ لاحق ہے، اس لیے تمام ممالک کو اپنی صفیں درست کرنا ہوں گی۔ اجلاس کے انتظامات کے حوالے سے لیفٹیننٹ جنرل (ر) نعمان محمود، جو کہ کمیٹی کے سیکریٹری جنرل ہیں، اہم ادارہ جاتی امور سر انجام دے رہے ہیں۔

اجلاس کے پرامن انعقاد اور سیکیورٹی خدشات کے پیش نظر آج اسلام آباد اور راولپنڈی میں مقامی تعطیل کا اعلان کیا گیا ہے، جس کے تحت تمام اسکول، کالجز اور دفاتر بند رہیں گے، البتہ تعلیمی اداروں کے شیڈول کے مطابق سالانہ اور ضمنی امتحانات اپنے وقت پر منعقد ہوں گے۔

یہ پہلا موقع ہے کہ اس مشترکہ کمیٹی کا اجلاس پاکستان میں منعقد ہو رہا ہے، جبکہ اس سے قبل اس قسم کے اجلاس استنبول اور ریاض میں ہو چکے ہیں۔ سفارتی ذرائع کے مطابق اجلاس سے ایک روز قبل تینوں ممالک کے سینئر حکام نے اسلام آباد میں ایک ابتدائی صلاح مشورتی اجلاس بھی منعقد کیا تھا۔

stories.title: Death Toll Rises to Four After Karachi Building Collapse
stories.summary:
Rescue workers pulled another body from the wreckage of a collapsed six-storey building located in the Admin Society near Baloch Colony in Karachi, raising the overall death toll to four. A spokesperson for the Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Centre confirmed that three deceased individuals and fourteen wounded people were initially brought in following the disaster. Out of those injured, thirteen individuals were discharged after receiving medical treatment, while one person continues to receive care at the medical facility.

Local law enforcement authorities registered a formal case regarding the structural failure, incorporating charges of murder, negligence, and carelessness. Police reported that ten individuals have been officially nominated in connection with the incident, and four suspects have been taken into custody so far. The disaster site in the densely populated eastern sector of the city drew large crowds and numerous rescue personnel, who worked to clear heavy bricks and twisted metal while family members displayed photographs of missing relatives on phones at a nearby information desk.

Building failures occur frequently across Pakistan due to substandard construction materials and lax safety enforcement. In Karachi, a metropolis exceeding twenty million residents, problems such as unauthorized building extensions, weak regulatory oversight, overcrowding, and deteriorating infrastructure remain widespread. Following this latest tragedy, the Sindh government initiated a major administrative reshuffle under Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah, removing Sindh Building Control Authority Director General Waseem Shamshad, suspending multiple local officials including the East Deputy Commissioner and East Senior Superintendent of Police, and ordering formal inquiries into the incident.

stories.title: Karachi Police Issue Traffic Advisory Following Highway Closure Due to Protest
stories.summary:
Traffic movement has been completely halted on both directions of the Main National Highway near the Sassi Toll Plaza heading toward Ghaghar Phatak. The closure was implemented on Thursday by Karachi Traffic Police because of an ongoing demonstration in the area.

To manage the disruption, authorities have set up alternative routes for commuters. Vehicles arriving from Thatta are being redirected away from ICI Chowk. Compact automobiles are instructed to take a left turn toward the FFC factory zone, Steel Mills, and Steel Mills Chowrangi.

Additionally, motorists driving from Steel Mills toward Ghaghar Phatak can utilize a link road situated at the T-junction prior to the Sassi Toll Plaza, which connects back to Thatta via the Super Highway. Law enforcement officers are stationed at the location to oversee and regulate traffic movement.

Officials have urged the public to utilize the suggested detours to prevent travel difficulties. Residents seeking further instructions can reach the traffic police helpline at 1915 or check live updates broadcasted on FM 88.6.

stories.title: Bilawal Rejects Referendum on New Provinces as Highly Controversial
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari expressed strong opposition to holding a referendum on establishing new administrative provinces, warning it would become the most controversial such vote in national history. Speaking at a press conference in Multan, Bilawal argued that wasting time on a public vote is unnecessary because Parliament possesses the authority to create new provinces directly. He emphasized that utilizing a parliamentary, constitutional, and democratic process is the best way to forge necessary political consensus on the matter.

During his address, the PPP chairman noted that while the Punjab Assembly previously passed a resolution supporting a new province under the PML-N government, the Sindh Assembly has consistently rejected similar proposals to divide Sindh. He clarified that his party maintains a uniform stance across provinces and reiterated his personal opposition to splitting Punjab into four separate regions. Shifting to the broader national context, Bilawal stressed that Pakistan requires a democratic reset to restore public faith in governance and tackle pressing national obstacles effectively.

Bilawal urged political stakeholders to diagnose the underlying causes behind the repeated breakdowns of the 1973 Constitution, praising the 18th Amendment for its unique strength. He also encouraged opposition parties to participate in the parliamentary committee focused on electoral reforms, noting that elections will continuously face allegations of rigging from both ruling and opposition factions unless broad political consensus is achieved. Furthermore, he highlighted the recent passage of the 27th Amendment with a two-thirds majority as a significant legislative milestone achieved through cooperation.

stories.title: SEPCO Announces Scheduled Power Outages Across Multiple Feeders for Maintenance
stories.summary:
The Sukkur Electric Power Company Limited (SEPCO) has scheduled a temporary electricity suspension across 24 feeders in various regions. The shutdown is planned for Friday, November 27, 2026, to facilitate necessary maintenance work on the electrical grid.

According to announcements from SEPCO’s Public Relations Office based in Sukkur, power will be cut off between 9:00 AM and either 2:00 PM or 3:00 PM, relying on the specific location. The affected infrastructure includes lines under the 132 kV Khairpur, Shahdad Kot, Ghotki, Khanpur Mahar, Daharki, Larkana New, Ratodero, Larkana Site, Shikarpur, Thull, Dadu, and Sukkur Site jurisdictions, alongside the 66 kV Nara-I network.

Specific areas facing disruptions include Hospital Road in Khairpur, Industrial zones in Mirpur Mathelo and Ghotki, City-IV in Shahdad Kot and Shikarpur, and Salehpat under Nara-I. Other impacted spots involve New Sarhad City, Khanpur City, Shahi Bazar in Daharki, Nazar, and various industrial and trading facilities.

SEPCO has formally extended an apology to all affected electricity consumers for the temporary inconvenience brought on by these essential grid servicing operations.

stories.title: New Study Reveals Alternative Electrical Signaling Mechanism Between Heart Cells
stories.summary:
Heart muscle cells may transmit electrical impulses through a secondary pathway alongside traditional direct channels, according to new research published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. For over fifty years, scientific consensus centered exclusively on gap junctions, which are microscopic channels allowing direct electrical current flow between adjacent cells.

A research team directed by postdoctoral researcher Xiaobo Wu within Robert Gourdie’s laboratory at the Fralin Biomedical Research Institute at VTC uncovered evidence supporting an alternative mechanism known as ephaptic coupling. This process utilizes voltage fluctuations within the perinexus, a nanoscale gap measuring tens of nanometers across where neighboring cardiac cells interface.

To examine this microscopic handoff, Wu engineered a novel technique termed Single-on-Paired, recording electrical readings from a single mouse heart cell while preserving its natural connection to another. Experiments revealed a distinct electrical signature that vanished when sodium levels dropped and gap junctions were experimentally inhibited, but reappeared upon restoring sodium even while gap junctions remained blocked.

Seth Weinberg, a biomedical engineering professor at The Ohio State University, developed a computer model that successfully mirrored the experimental data, demonstrating how local electrical fields can stimulate adjacent cells. Steven Poelzing noted that understanding these pathways could aid investigations into irregular heart rhythms like atrial fibrillation, which impacts over 10 million American adults.

stories.title: Brazilian Delegation Visits NARC to Explore Pakistan Livestock and Goat Breeds
stories.summary:
A high-ranking delegation from Brazil visited the National Agricultural Research Centre in Islamabad to examine Pakistan's indigenous goat breeds and local livestock research. Headed by Rafael Guimarães Requião, Deputy Secretary for Trade and International Relations, the visitors expressed keen interest in the country's diverse genetic resources for meat production.

Talks centered on prospective partnerships involving livestock breeding, genetic enhancement, and the sharing of goat germplasm. Both parties also investigated avenues for joint scientific studies, technology transfer, and creating commercially viable goat breeds suited for meat production.

Federal Minister for National Food Security and Research Rana Tanveer Hussain has been working to modernize Pakistan's agricultural research framework and elevate the livestock industry. His strategy emphasizes commercializing local genetic assets, implementing advanced breeding techniques, and turning the nation's livestock capacity into export-driven economic ventures.

Pakistan Agricultural Research Council Chairman Dr Syed Murtaza Hassan Andrabi has similarly championed international scientific cooperation to bolster institutional partnerships. The delegation's interest represents a significant milestone in agricultural ties between Pakistan and Brazil, opening pathways to convert indigenous genetic wealth into commercial export success.

stories.title: Sindh Orders Three-Year Inquiry Into Building Control Authority Regulations
stories.summary:
The Sindh government has initiated a comprehensive three-year investigation into the Sindh Building Control Authority (SBCA) to uncover unauthorized constructions and violations of building laws. This inquiry spans from December 1, 2023, to November 30, 2026, and has been tasked to the Chief Minister’s Inspection, Inquiries and Implementation Team under the direction of Chairman Bilal Memon. The probe will examine unlawful building approvals, administrative irregularities, rule breaches, and the underlying causes of structural collapses, building demolitions, and related casualties.

A specialized committee consisting of Member-I and Member-III of the Chief Minister’s Inspection Team has been established to execute the review. Investigators are directed to scrutinize the actions of the SBCA director general, additional director generals, town directors, regional officials in Hyderabad and Sukkur, Karachi town directors, assistant directors, and building inspectors. The inquiry will determine individual accountability for officers linked to illicit building practices.

The SBCA has received instructions to provide comprehensive records by 11 am on December 1, 2026, and to finalize its report with recommendations within a 15-day window. The requested documentation encompasses approved building plans, officer postings, court stay orders, pending litigation, details of the legal department's performance, and records concerning the technical committee for dangerous buildings. Additionally, the committee has demanded standard operating procedures, relevant guidelines, and clear jurisdictions for officials regarding completion certificates and demolition protocols.

This investigation matters as it targets systemic administrative lapses and enforcement failures within regional urban planning oversight. By identifying culpable officials and reviewing past building approvals, the provincial government aims to address ongoing safety hazards and property destruction linked to unauthorized construction across Sindh.

stories.title: Rana Irfan Sweeps Mohammad Asif to Win IBSF Men's World Cup
stories.summary:
Pakistan cueist Rana Irfan secured the IBSF Men’s World Cup title in Muscat, Oman, after delivering a dominant 5-0 victory over compatriot Mohammad Asif at the Active Oman Sports and Entertainment Hub. The triumph served as redemption for Irfan, who previously lost to the three-time world champion Asif in the National Championship final back in January despite firing multiple century breaks. In the final on Thursday, Irfan claimed victory with frame scores including breaks of 56, 46, and 68 to decisively seal the match.

Irfan’s journey to the championship match began with a 4-2 quarter-final win over compatriot Mubashir Raza. In the semi-finals, he faced another tough compatriot, Asjad Iqbal, recovering from a sixth-frame century break by Asjad to win a tense deciding frame 69-15. Meanwhile, Asif advanced to the final by defeating England's Harvey Chandler 4-1 in the quarter-finals and Afghanistan's Mohammad Rais Senzahi 4-1 in the semi-finals. Asjad Iqbal earned a bronze medal, allowing Pakistan to sweep all three podium positions in the men's singles event.

Following his emotional victory, a tearful Irfan expressed his joy and noted that this international tournament marked his debut representing Pakistan. He pointed out the limited exposure available in snooker but emphasized the importance of seizing rare competitive chances. The success highlights Pakistan's strength in the sport, with the team event scheduled to start on Friday as defending champions.

This victory is a major milestone for Irfan's career, establishing his international prowess while cementing Pakistan's dominant presence in global cue sports. The clean sweep in Muscat underscores the depth of national talent heading into the upcoming team competitions.

stories.title: Pakistan Slightly Reduces Petrol and Diesel Prices Despite Global Rises
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government has announced a modest reduction in domestic fuel prices, lowering the price of petrol by Re1 to Rs313 per litre and high-speed diesel by Rs2 to Rs346 per litre. These revised rates, regulated by the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) under the official pricing mechanism, take effect on Friday, November 27, 2026. This follows a previous reduction on Wednesday that had decreased petrol by Rs4 and high-speed diesel by Rs5.

Internationally, crude oil prices rebounded by about $1 on Thursday, reversing earlier losses. This global upward shift was triggered by supply disruption concerns in the Middle East after Yemen’s Houthis claimed an attack on Saudi Arabia’s largest oil refinery, and reports surfaced of mines striking ships in the Strait of Hormuz. Consequently, Brent crude futures advanced $1.64 to reach $96.25 a barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate futures rose $1.10 to $84.78.

The domestic price adjustment runs counter to international upward trends, providing minor relief to local consumers amidst broader economic pressures. The ongoing volatility in global petroleum markets continues to influence regional energy planning and cost management strategies across Pakistan.

This policy decision matters because fuel costs directly impact transportation expenses, inflation, and general consumer purchasing power. Balancing international market shocks with domestic price relief remains a central challenge for state regulators managing the country's energy sector.

stories.title: Pakistan Lowers Fuel Prices Again as Government Maintains Strict Levies
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government implemented another downward revision in domestic fuel costs, lowering petrol by Re1 per litre to Rs313 and high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs2 per litre to Rs346, effective Friday, November 27, 2026. According to notifications from the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (Ogra), these reductions follow Wednesday's price cuts, bringing both fuels below their July 18 levels. Despite these adjustments, the state continues to impose significant taxes and duties, collecting Rs114 per litre on petrol and Rs100 per litre on diesel.

To cushion the public against high energy costs driven by ongoing Middle East conflicts, authorities have utilized various relief mechanisms. An arrangement established on November 2 allows oil refineries to absorb a cumulative impact of Rs15 billion toward the petroleum levy, facilitating a Rs14.71 reduction for consumers. Additionally, the Prime Minister’s Fuel Relief Scheme, launched on September 17, provides targeted subsidies for owners of motorcycles, rickshaws, and vehicles up to 800cc. Authorities have also enforced austerity measures, such as 9 pm market closures and a 50 percent cut in official vehicle fuel allocations.

Fuel prices in Pakistan have experienced frequent revisions since mid-July due to shifting international markets and geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran. Petrol and HSD remain vital revenue generators with monthly sales volumes of 700,000 to 800,000 tonnes. Price fluctuations directly influence the middle and lower-middle classes who rely on small vehicles and two-wheelers, as well as the heavy transport sector and power generators dependent on diesel.

This ongoing adjustment highlights the government's dual approach of maintaining vital tax revenues while deploying targeted subsidies and austerity protocols. Managing these energy dynamics is crucial for safeguarding lower-income populations against regional supply disruptions and volatile global commodity markets.

stories.title: TTAP Claims National Government Is Sole Solution to Political Crisis
stories.summary:
The Tehreek-i-Tahafuz-i-Ayin-i-Pakistan (TTAP) declared on Thursday that establishing a national government remains the exclusive remedy for the ongoing political and constitutional upheaval in the country. TTAP Chairman and National Assembly Opposition Leader Mahmood Khan Achakzai previously floated this recommendation alongside broad political and constitutional reforms earlier in the week. However, the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI), acting as the primary opposition party, distanced itself from the proposal after a majority of members in a joint parliamentary group meeting opposed the concept.

Speaking in Islamabad, TTAP spokesperson Akhunzada Hussain Ahmed Yousafzai explained that a national government could facilitate the release of incarcerated PTI founder and former prime minister Imran Khan, who has remained imprisoned since August 5, 2023. Nevertheless, Yousafzai emphasized that such a coalition cannot be forced upon the public or negotiated in secret. He insisted that all political factions, especially the PTI and its imprisoned leader, must participate in consultations to preserve democratic legitimacy and avoid unilateral decisions or political victimization.

The proposed initiative aims to rebuild public trust in democratic institutions and ease political tensions without targeting specific groups or serving as a permanent substitute for the electorate's will. Yousafzai stated that the primary objective of this interim framework would be restoring fundamental rights, constitutional freedoms, and political activities, alongside guaranteeing free, fair, and transparent general elections. Furthermore, the TTAP called for an independent Election Commission of Pakistan headed by a mutually agreed, non-partisan chief election commissioner.

To achieve this consensus, the spokesperson proposed convening a multi-party conference prior to forming the national administration to establish a clear framework for credible elections. Yousafzai cautioned that the arrangement must not replace the people's mandate or act as a lasting political setup, stressing instead that governing authority must stem entirely from a free and fair public vote under a unified constitution and independent electoral system.

stories.title: Regulator Decreases Petroleum Prices as Dealers Demand Refinery Audit
stories.summary:
The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) announced a reduction in petroleum prices through an official notification, lowering the cost of petrol by Rs1 per litre to Rs313 and diesel by Rs2 per litre to Rs346. These revised rates are scheduled to take effect on November 27. The price adjustment follows public discussions surrounding fuel costs and industry profitability across the country.

Ahead of the announcement, petroleum dealers gathered in Karachi for an emergency meeting to address refinery profits, pricing structures, and consumer relief. During the session, industry representatives including Malik Khuda Bakhsh and Anwar Kamal called for a transparent forensic audit of financial records for all oil refineries. Dealers alleged that these refineries accumulated excessive profits, equivalent to a full year's earnings in just three months.

According to the petroleum dealers, examining the refineries' financial affairs could uncover significant room for price reductions. Kamal asserted that a proper examination might allow authorities to grant consumers relief ranging from Rs40 to Rs50 per litre on petrol. Furthermore, the participants claimed that recent statements from the petroleum minister validated their concerns regarding high profit margins within the sector.

The dealers argued that a comprehensive financial investigation is necessary to determine past earnings and prevent future financial burdens on citizens. They maintained that a transparent review of refinery profits would ensure fair pricing and direct relief for consumers dependent on petroleum products.

stories.title: مولانا فضل الرحمان حالات کو تصادم کی طرف لے جانا چاہتے ہیں: عطا تارڑ
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر اطلاعات عطا تارڑ نے جیو نیوز کے پروگرام میں گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ مولانا فضل الرحمان غصے میں ہیں اور حالات کو تصادم کی طرف دھکیلنا چاہتے ہیں۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ بلاول بھٹو اگر خود کنفیوز رہنا چاہتے ہیں تو رہیں مگر عوام کو الجھن کا شکار نہ کریں، اور سوال کیا کہ انہیں عوامی رائے سے اتنا خوف کیوں ہے۔

اسی پروگرام میں سینیٹ میں اپوزیشن لیڈر علامہ راجا ناصر عباس نے بیان دیا کہ وہ بانی پی ٹی آئی کو مائنس نہیں ہونے دیں گے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ جب تک وہ بانی پی ٹی آئی کے منہ سے خود نہیں سن لیتے، تب تک وہ نئے صوبوں اور ریفرنڈم کی حمایت نہیں کریں گے، کیونکہ ایسا کرنا بانی پی ٹی آئی کے بیانیے سے انحراف ہوگا۔

دوسری جانب پاکستان، ترکی اور سعودی عرب کے مکہ دفاعی مشترکہ معاہدے کے تحت اسٹریٹیجک سیاسی و دفاعی کمیٹی کا اہم اجلاس کل جمعہ کو اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوگا۔ اجلاس میں تینوں ملکوں کے وزرائے خارجہ اور اعلیٰ عسکری حکام کی شرکت متوقع ہے، اور معاہدے کے تحت سعودی عرب کا دفاع تینوں ممالک کی مشترکہ ذمے داری ہے۔

مختلف شہروں میں دیگر انتظامی اور قانونی امور بھی جاری ہیں جن میں لاہور کے ستوکتلہ میں نجی اسپتال سے لاش کی برآمدگی، اسلام آباد میں فاطمہ اصغر قتل کیس کی سماعت، اور ایف آئی اے کی جانب سے انسانی اسمگلر کی گرفتاری شامل ہیں۔ حکام ان تمام معاملات پر اپنی قانونی اور انتظامی کارروائیاں جاری رکھے ہوئے ہیں۔

stories.title: گلگت بلتستان کی خطرناک فیری میڈوز سڑک پر خاتون نے جیپ چلا دی
stories.summary:
گلگت بلتستان کی انتہائی خطرناک اور دشوار گزار فیری میڈوز سڑک پر پشاور سے تعلق رکھنے والی 39 سالہ خاتون رفیعہ قاسم بیگ نے جیپ چلا کر ایک منفرد اور شاندار مہم سر کی ہے۔ یہ سڑک اپنی تنگ گزرگاہوں، خطرناک موڑوں، گہری کھائیوں اور پہاڑی ڈھلوانوں کی وجہ سے دنیا کی خطرناک ترین سڑکوں میں شمار ہوتی ہے جہاں عام طور پر صرف مقامی اور ماہر ڈرائیور ہی گاڑی چلاتے ہیں۔

رفیعہ قاسم بیگ نے 24 نومبر کو اس کٹھن راستے پر اپنی جرأت، خود اعتمادی اور ڈرائیونگ کی مہارت کا مظاہرہ کرتے ہوئے خود رضاکارانہ طور پر جیپ چلائی۔ ان کا یہ خطرناک سفر خواتین کے لیے ایڈونچر ڈرائیونگ کے شعبے میں ایک بڑی حوصلہ افزا مثال کے طور پر سامنے آیا ہے۔

خاتون نے اپنی اس شاندار اور بہادرانہ کاوش کو پاکستان کے تمام ان شہداء کے نام منسوب کیا ہے جن کی قربانیاں ملک سے محبت، وفاداری اور حب الوطنی کی روشن مثال ہیں۔ اس مہم نے ملک بھر میں خواتین کی ہمت اور صلاحیتوں کو اجاگر کیا ہے۔

یہ واقعہ ایسے وقت میں سامنے آیا ہے جب ملک کے مختلف حصوں میں سیاسی سرگرمیاں، دفاعی اجلاس اور انتظامی امور بھی ساتھ ساتھ چل رہے ہیں، تاہم فیری میڈوز پر اس خاتون کی کامیابی نے ایک الگ ہی تاریخ رقم کی ہے۔

stories.title: Authorities Review Satellite Lead on Missing PIA Flight PK-404
stories.summary:
Aviation authorities are examining a potential new lead concerning the disappearance of Pakistan International Airlines (PIA) Flight PK-404, which vanished 37 years ago. The inquiry began after a student from Hyderabad named Fasih Ali spent five months studying satellite photographs and Google Earth data following a documentary about the aircraft. Ali identified unusual shapes resembling aircraft debris on a glacier in Tajikistan, though satellite imagery alone cannot verify the origin of the objects.

Air Commodore Ahsan Nauman, head of the Bureau of Aircraft Safety Investigation, confirmed that the bureau noted the report and initiated technical steps to assess the site. However, physical inspection of the location poses significant challenges due to its remote, high-altitude setting, which makes access and verification extremely difficult. Recent weeks have seen various media outlets publish reports regarding these satellite-based claims, often featuring conflicting details concerning the researchers and mountain locations near the Wakhan and Pamir corridor.

Unverified claims and speculation regarding the historical flight frequently resurface online. Flight PK-404 was a domestic journey carrying 54 passengers and crew members when it disappeared on August 25, 1989, while traveling from Gilgit to Islamabad. Over three decades later, search efforts have failed to locate any confirmed wreckage or survivors from the incident.

stories.title: Norway Football Chief Admits Removing FIFA President Infantino Remains Difficult
stories.summary:
Lise Klaveness, head of the Norwegian Football Federation and a vocal critic of FIFA, stated on Thursday that unseating FIFA President Gianni Infantino will be difficult, though the possibility remains open. Klaveness has opposed Infantino since the 2022 World Cup in Qatar and demanded his resignation in August following several controversies during this year's tournament hosted across the United States, Canada, and Mexico. Speaking to foreign media in Oslo, the 45-year-old lawyer and former player acknowledged Infantino's strong backing.

While the European football confederation UEFA supports French football chief Philippe Diallo for the upcoming March election, Infantino maintains the backing of African, South American, and Asian confederations, making him the tournament favorite. Klaveness noted that the political landscape remains volatile, meaning outcomes can shift unexpectedly. Although the Confederation of African Football (CAF) and CONMEBOL reaffirmed their support for Infantino, she emphasized that national federations cast the secret votes rather than the continental bodies, keeping the election contest viable.

Klaveness also expressed hope that Diallo and a third candidate, Japanese federation honorary president Kozo Tashima, might combine forces against the incumbent president. Infantino, who has led FIFA since 2016, faced criticism recently over several issues. These controversies include accusations of running a centralized administration, awarding a FIFA peace prize to Donald Trump, lifting the suspension of American player Folarin Balogun during the 2026 World Cup, and previously floating commercial rights proposals that were later abandoned.

stories.title: Makkah Pact Nations to Meet in Islamabad to Discuss Yemen
stories.summary:
Representatives from Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan are scheduled to convene in Islamabad for a high-level meeting. Pakistan's defense minister, Khawaja Asif, confirmed that the ongoing conflict in Yemen between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis will be a primary agenda item during Thursday's discussions.

The three Muslim-majority nations established the mutual defense agreement in August, which dictates that any military aggression against Saudi Arabia is considered an attack on all member states. While the pact remains in a nascent development stage following its formation amid Middle Eastern tensions, officials aim to solidify operational procedures over the coming months.

During discussions, Khawaja Asif noted that regional security extends beyond the immediate conflict with the Houthis. He identified potential security risks originating from Israel and highlighted Pakistan's previous diplomatic interventions between Washington and Tehran.

The upcoming consultations in Islamabad are part of broader regional diplomatic efforts to coordinate security policies. However, officials noted that ongoing international mediation remains fragile as governments work to establish long-term stability.

This mutual defense framework underscores the commitment of Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey to address shared security challenges collaboratively. The meeting provides a platform for defense and foreign ministers to align their strategies regarding ongoing regional turmoil.

stories.title: State Bank of Pakistan Foreign Exchange Reserves Rise by $8 Million
stories.summary:
Foreign exchange reserves held by the State Bank of Pakistan grew by $8 million to reach $21.60 billion during the week ending November 20, 2026. This minor increase brought the nation's total liquid foreign reserves to $26.75 billion by the close of the review period. Commercial banks held net foreign reserves amounting to $5.15 billion during the exact same week.

According to official central bank figures released on Thursday, the reserves specifically touched $21,595.0 million by November 20. This follows an earlier upward movement from the preceding week ending November 13, 2026, when SBP-held reserves had similarly grown by $15 million to stand at $21.59 billion.

The persistent tracking of these financial figures is critical for monitoring the country's external economic stability and its capacity to manage international trade obligations. These weekly indicators provide key insights into liquid assets available to support national currency values and manage external debt responsibilities.

Market observers and financial analysts regularly review these updates from the central bank to gauge broader macroeconomic health. The latest data underscores incremental improvements in the nation's reserve position amid ongoing domestic and international financial measures.

stories.title: NADRA Announces Winter Operating Hours Across Nine Punjab Districts
stories.summary:
The National Database and Registration Authority has implemented revised winter operating schedules for registration and mega centres across nine specific districts in Punjab. The updated timings affect facilities located within Lahore, Kasur, Nankana Sahib, Sheikhupura, Narowal, Gujranwala, Wazirabad, Sialkot, and Okara.

Under the new framework, single-shift registration centres operating on a five or six-day schedule will remain open from 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM, Monday through Saturday or Friday depending on their individual local arrangements. Meanwhile, double-shift registration centres will function from 8:30 AM to 10:30 PM on their assigned working days.

Double-shift mega centres under the authority will maintain hours from 8:00 AM until 11:45 PM. However, facilities providing round-the-clock services are exempt from these adjustments and will continue functioning under their standard schedules without alterations.

Additionally, all affected service centres will observe a mandatory break for Friday prayers, suspending operations entirely between 1:00 PM and 2:00 PM before resuming normal tasks. Citizens are urged to verify the adjusted schedules via the official website or helpline 1777 prior to visiting for identity issuance, renewals, or biometric verification.

stories.title: Government and Jamaat-i-Islami to Form Joint Economic Relief Committee
stories.summary:
The federal government and Jamaat-i-Islami have agreed to establish a dedicated committee to further evaluate and execute economic recommendations proposed by the political party. This decision stems from their tenth round of negotiations regarding petroleum levy relief, following a formal meeting at the PM House in Islamabad between Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and JI chief Hafiz Naeemur Rehman.

The high-level gathering included prominent government officials such as Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar, Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik, Information Minister Attaullah Tarar, and political adviser Rana Sanaullah, alongside a JI delegation led by Vice Emir Liaqat Baloch. Prime Minister Shehbaz expressed appreciation for the party's constructive dialogue, noting that consultations were conducted with sincerity to aid citizens facing soaring fuel costs driven by the Middle East crisis.

During the discussions, the prime minister highlighted previous relief efforts, including the allocation of over Rs128 billion from the development budget and the launch of the Prime Minister’s Fuel Relief Scheme in September, which provided targeted assistance to nearly 20 million users of two-wheelers and vehicles up to 800cc. While acknowledging the accessibility of these measures, the JI chief contended they remained insufficient to combat mounting inflation and maintained that his party retains the right to peaceful resistance for broader public relief.

The formation of this new implementation committee marks a pivotal step following months of demonstrations, proposed nationwide strikes, and postponed protest marches over heavy petroleum levies. Both leadership sides expressed optimism that the committee's collaborative framework will yield positive, practical outcomes for low-income households in upcoming budgetary cycles.

stories.title: Trump Asks Putin to Halt Military Aggression in Europe
stories.summary:
United States President Donald Trump stated on Thursday that he urged Russian leader Vladimir Putin to halt military aggression across European territories during their recent meeting in China. This appeal signals a notable shift in tone from Trump, who had referred to the Russian president as his friend just a week prior during talks in Shenzhen alongside Chinese President Xi Jinping.

The renewed diplomatic push aims to facilitate a swift settlement to the ongoing conflict in Ukraine, although Trump's specific public remarks on his Truth Social network did not explicitly mention Ukraine by name. The statements follow mounting European anxiety over escalating provocations, highlighted by an incident where three Russian cruise missiles crossed into Poland.

Trump’s updated stance comes immediately after hosting NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte in Florida for joint discussions. In a subsequent joint statement, Trump and Rutte stressed the critical necessity of preventing Russia from taking any intentional or unintentional actions that might broaden the war in Europe.

Unlike previous instances where Trump placed equal responsibility on Kyiv for conducting deep strikes inside Russia, his latest remarks omitted any demands for restraint from Ukraine. This diplomatic pivot has closely followed a recent prisoner swap in which Ukraine reported receiving 250 bodies from Russia.

stories.title: Maritime Minister Urges 5% Value Addition for Seafood Exports
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Maritime Affairs Muhammad Junaid Chaudhry has proposed that seafood exporters allocate at least five percent of their total exports to value-added products. The recommendation was announced while he presided over a meeting in Islamabad aimed at exploring methods to boost the seafood sector's exports. Currently, only three out of 578 seafood exporters deal in value-added goods.

To drive this initiative, the minister established a committee led by Fisheries Development Commissioner Dr. Muhammad Hafeez-ur-Rehman. This group will collaborate with provincial authorities and exporters to identify opportunities, suggest strategies, and promote processed seafood products to increase foreign exchange revenues. Officials from the ministries of maritime affairs and national food security, alongside provincial fisheries representatives via video link, participated in the discussions.

Chaudhry advised businesses to begin value-addition activities on a small scale and gradually expand into processing and packaging to reach higher-value international markets. He also proposed a stakeholder workshop to identify barriers and formulate practical recommendations. Furthermore, he emphasized that government collaboration with provincial administrations and the private sector is necessary to expand processing facilities and build aquaculture infrastructure, specifically shrimp hatcheries, to enhance export competitiveness.

stories.title: فاطمہ اصغر قتل کیس: اسلام آباد سیشن کورٹ کا جوڈیشل مجسٹریٹ کا حکم کالعدم قرار
stories.summary:
ڈسٹرکٹ اینڈ سیشن کورٹ اسلام آباد میں کمسن گھریلو ملازمہ فاطمہ اصغر قتل کیس میں دائر اپیل پر سماعت ہوئی ہے۔ ایڈیشنل سیشن جج آصف محمود نے اضافی دفعات کے خلاف دائر اپیل پر اپنا فیصلہ سنا دیا ہے۔ عدالت نے 20 اور 23 نومبر کو دیے جانے والے جوڈیشل مجسٹریٹ کے احکامات کو کالعدم قرار دے دیا ہے۔

عدالتی فیصلے کے متن کے مطابق، جوڈیشل مجسٹریٹ تفتیشی افسر کو تفتیش کے طریقہ کار سے متعلق تفصیلی ہدایات جاری نہیں کر سکتا۔ فیصلے میں واضح کیا گیا کہ تفتیشی افسر کو بچی کی عمر، تعلیمی ریکارڈ، گھریلو ملازمت اور دیگر دستیاب شواہد کا جائزہ لینے سے نہیں روکا جا سکتا۔

عدالت نے ہدایت کی کہ تفتیشی افسر قانون کے مطابق آزادانہ، منصفانہ اور مکمل تفتیش کو یقینی بنائے۔ عدالت کا کہنا تھا کہ تفتیشی افسر کو مخصوص دفعات شامل کرنے اور مخصوص تفتیشی اقدامات کے احکامات دینا اختیارات سے تجاوز ہے۔

عدالت نے ملزمان کے جسمانی ریمانڈ میں مداخلت کی درخواست کو مسترد کر دیا۔ فیصلے میں بتایا گیا کہ چونکہ دونوں ملزمان نے جسمانی ریمانڈ کو چیلنج نہیں کیا تھا، اس لیے ان کا ریمانڈ برقرار رہے گا۔

عدالت نے تفتیشی افسر کو حکم دیا کہ وہ شواہد کی بنیاد پر خود قابلِ اطلاق قانونی دفعات کا تعین کرے اور تفتیشی عمل کے دوران کسی بھی فریق کے سماجی، مالی یا سرکاری اثر و رسوخ سے مکمل طور پر آزاد رہے۔ اس کے علاوہ یہ بھی واضح کیا گیا کہ پولی گرافک ٹیسٹ کی اجازت سے متعلق الگ حکم کو موجودہ درخواست میں چیلنج نہیں کیا گیا تھا۔

stories.title: مکہ دفاعی مشترکہ معاہدے کی اسٹریٹیجک سیاسی و دفاعی کمیٹی کا اہم اجلاس کل ہوگا
stories.summary:
اسلام آباد میں جمعہ کے روز مکہ دفاعی مشترکہ معاہدے کے تحت پاکستان، ترکیہ اور سعودی عرب کی اسٹریٹیجک سیاسی و دفاعی کمیٹی کا اہم اجلاس منعقد ہوگا۔ اس اجلاس میں تینوں ملکوں کے وزرائے خارجہ اور اعلیٰ دفاعی و عسکری حکام کی شرکت متوقع ہے۔

سفارتی ذرائع کے مطابق مکہ جوائنٹ ڈیفنس معاہدے کے تحت قائم اسٹریٹجک سیاسی و دفاعی کمیٹی کے اس اجلاس میں تینوں ملکوں کی اعلیٰ سطح کی سیاسی، دفاعی اور عسکری قیادت شریک ہو گی۔ اجلاس کے دوران تینوں ممالک کے درمیان مشترکہ دفاعی تعاون کو مزید مضبوط بنانے، علاقائی سلامتی کی صورت حال اور مشترکہ سیکیورٹی چیلنجز پر تفصیلی تبادلہ خیال کیا جائے گا۔

ذرائع کا کہنا ہے کہ اجلاس میں تینوں ممالک کے وزرائے خارجہ اور وزرائے دفاع کے علاوہ اعلیٰ عسکری اور انٹیلی جنس حکام بھی شرکت کریں گے۔ مکہ جوائنٹ ڈیفنس معاہدے کے تحت قائم کمیٹی کے سیکریٹری جنرل لیفٹیننٹ جنرل ریٹائرڈ نعمان محمود اجلاس کے انتظامی اور ادارہ جاتی امور میں اہم کردار ادا کریں گے۔

سفارتی ذرائع کے مطابق تینوں ممالک کے سینئر حکام کا ابتدائی اجلاس جمعرات کے روز اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہو چکا ہے، جبکہ وزرائے خارجہ، وزرائے دفاع اور اعلیٰ عسکری حکام کا مرکزی اجلاس جمعہ کو متوقع ہے۔ اس سے قبل اس کمیٹی کے اجلاس استنبول اور ریاض میں منعقد ہو چکے ہیں، اور اسلام آباد میں ہونے والا یہ اجلاس پاکستان میں اس کمیٹی کا پہلا اجلاس ہوگا۔

stories.title: مراد علی شاہ کا کہنا ہے کہ امن و امان برقرار رکھنا ہماری پہلی ترجیح ہے
stories.summary:
سندھ کے وزیر اعلیٰ سید مراد علی شاہ نے کراچی میں ایک پریس کانفرنس سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ 29 نومبر کے لیے ایک سیاسی جماعت نے بہت پہلے ریلی کی درخواست دی تھی، جبکہ میڈیا کے ذریعے معلوم ہوا کہ متحدہ قومی موومنٹ (ایم کیو ایم) بھی اسی روز ریلی نکالنا چاہتی ہے۔

وزیر اعلیٰ سندھ نے واضح کیا کہ ان کی حکومت کی اولین ترجیح صوبے میں امن و امان کا قیام ہے۔ انہوں نے بتایا کہ اس سلسلے میں تمام متعلقہ تینوں جماعتوں سے بات چیت کی گئی ہے اور انہوں نے موثر جواب دیا ہے، جبکہ محکمہ قانون امن و امان کی صورتحال کا جائزہ لے کر ہی اجازت دے گا۔

پریس کانفرنس کے دوران مراد علی شاہ نے یہ بھی ذکر کیا کہ انہوں نے سندھ کے وزیر قانون کو ہدایت کی ہے کہ وہ سندھ ہائی کورٹ کے چیف جسٹس سے ملاقات کریں اور درخواست کریں کہ غیر قانونی عمارتوں کے مقدمات کا فیصلہ پندرہ دن کے اندر کیا جائے۔

اس کے علاوہ کراچی میں ٹریفک کی روانی کو برقرار رکھنے کے لیے متبادل راستے بھی تجویز کیے گئے ہیں تاکہ کسی بھی سیاسی سرگرمی یا ریلی کے دوران عوام کو مشکلات کا سامنا نہ کرنا پڑے اور شہر میں نظم و ضبط قائم رہے۔

stories.title: لاہور: ستوکتلہ کے نجی انسداد منشیات اسپتال کے واش روم سے لڑکی کی لاش برآمد
stories.summary:
لاہور کے علاقے ستوکتلہ میں واقع ایک نجی انسداد منشیات اسپتال سے ایک لڑکی کی لاش پراسرار طور پر برآمد ہوئی ہے۔ پولیس کے مطابق تقریباً 30 سالہ لڑکی کی لاش اسپتال کے واش روم میں لٹکی ہوئی ملی ہے۔

پولیس حکام کا بتانا ہے کہ متوفیہ لڑکی کو ایک ہفتہ قبل ہی علاج کے لیے اس نجی اسپتال میں داخل کروایا گیا تھا۔ واقعہ کے بعد جب پولیس نے تحقیقات کا آغاز کیا تو ورثاء نے کسی بھی قسم کی قانونی کارروائی کروانے سے صاف انکار کر دیا۔

ورثاء کی جانب سے قانونی کارروائی سے انکار کے بعد پولیس نے عدالتی احکامات کی روشنی میں ضروری کارروائی مکمل کی۔ عدالتی حکم ملنے کے بعد اسپتال انتظامیہ اور پولیس نے لڑکی کی لاش کو تحویل سے نکال کر اس کے ورثاء کے حوالے کر دیا۔

اس واقعے کی مزید تحقیقات متعلقہ پولیس کی جانب سے جاری ہیں تاکہ موت کے اصل حقائق کا تعین کیا جا سکے، جبکہ اسپتال انتظامیہ سے بھی اس سلسلے میں پوچھ گچھ کی جا رہی ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistan Power Division Proposes Three-Month Fuel Cost Adjustment Plan
stories.summary:
Pakistan's Power Division has introduced a proposed three-month electricity fuel cost adjustment mechanism designed to limit consumer impacts from rising international fuel prices and provide tariff certainty. According to a spokesperson, the Forward-Looking Fuel Cost Adjustment mechanism will cap the increase at approximately Rs. 0.83 per unit, inclusive of taxes, for the period between October and December 2026, compared to the September 2026 fuel cost adjustment.

The government stated it has previously lowered tariffs since taking office in March 2024, when the national average stood at Rs. 53.04 per unit, down to Rs. 44.28 per unit by March 2026, before the onset of the Iran-US war and subsequent Middle Eastern energy crisis. Industrial tariffs similarly dropped from Rs. 62.99 to Rs. 44.50 over the same timeframe. However, global fuel price hikes pressured monthly fuel cost adjustments, though proactive measures between April and September 2026 prevented potential additional spikes of Rs. 6 to Rs. 7 per unit, restricting the combined FCA and Quarterly Tariff Adjustment increase to an average of Rs. 2.38 per unit inclusive of taxes.

Winter typically drives up electricity generation costs as hydropower declines and reliance on thermal power plants increases, with thermal fuels comprising over 80 percent of the generation mix in certain winter months. The ongoing elevated international fuel prices created risks for substantial monthly FCA hikes. Upon receiving required approvals, the Power Division will issue policy guidelines to the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority to implement the new mechanism.

stories.title: ECP Releases Delimitation Schedule and Freezes Boundaries for Nine KP Districts
stories.summary:
The Election Commission of Pakistan has released the schedule for the delimitation of village and neighbourhood councils across nine districts in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The affected districts are Karak, Hangu, Mansehra, Malakand, Shangla, Chitral Upper, Swat, Bar Swat, and Paharpur. Additionally, the commission directed that the boundaries of all administrative and revenue units within these districts be frozen immediately until the delimitation process concludes.

This action follows the ECP's earlier decision this month to halt local government election preparations across the province after the federal government extended the suspension of Article 140-A of the Constitution to Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. According to the newly issued timeline, administrative arrangements, including map and data procurement alongside committee training, will run from December 1 to December 9. Preliminary lists of councils will be prepared between December 10 and January 9, 2027, and published on January 10.

Objections to the preliminary lists can be filed from January 11 to January 27, 2027, with authorities disposing of them by February 15 and communicating decisions by February 23. Final lists will be officially notified on February 26. The ECP stated that freezing existing administrative and revenue units—such as tehsils, patwar halqas, and revenue estates—is necessary to prevent disruptions to the smooth progression of the delimitation proceedings.

stories.title: Elon Musk Pledges $18 Billion in SpaceX Shares for US Children
stories.summary:
Elon Musk has announced a plan to gift two SpaceX shares to every child in the United States, representing a total value of approximately $18 billion. Unveiled on the eve of Thanksgiving, the initiative follows the Federal Communications Commission's approval on Wednesday allowing SpaceX to deploy one million satellites for space-based data centers. The move coincides with intensified public and political scrutiny regarding the environmental impact and influence of technology billionaires.

Under the plan, children will receive one share from SpaceX and one personally from Musk. SpaceX stated it will contribute one newly issued Class A common stock share to every active Trump Account—a government program providing Americans under 18 with a stock market stake that has opened nearly 70 million accounts—while Musk will match the company's donation. SpaceX shares closed at $127.44 on Wednesday. The company shares will transfer next month, whereas Musk's personal shares will be transferred after his lockup expires in June.

Industry analysts note the pledge builds a massive, long-term retail shareholder base and creates a financial client pipeline for trading platforms as younger generations mature. The announcement also serves as a high-profile counter to rival AI firm Anthropic's recent commitment of five percent of its shares to a public good fund. Astronomers, meanwhile, expressed dismay over the FCC's satellite constellation approval, warning it threatens decades of federal investment in astronomical facilities and night sky observation.

stories.title: Bilawal Clarifies 'Brute Majority' Comment Regarding Constitutional Amendments
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari has clarified his previous reference to a "brute majority," explaining that his intention was to emphasize that constitutional amendments carry greater strength when passed with a broader consensus. Speaking during a press conference in Multan, he noted that although the constitutional changes achieved a two-thirds majority, efforts to twist his words into terms like "force" or "brutal" were inaccurate. He admitted it was a shortcoming of the PPP that the 26th and 27th Constitutional Amendments lacked the expansive consensus that the landmark 18th Amendment had successfully secured.

Elaborating on the legislative processes, Bilawal recalled that the 26th Constitutional Amendment emerged from the Charter of Democracy, requiring continuous effort to forge an agreement, with JUI-F chief Maulana Fazal ur Rehman seeking explicit permission prior to casting his vote to build trust. Regarding the 27th Constitutional Amendment, he hailed its passage by a two-thirds majority as a major milestone that ensured equal provincial representation in the nation's supreme court. He mentioned that discussions with dissatisfied judges highlighted the need for further judicial reforms.

To successfully restore public trust in the judiciary, the PPP chairman suggested implementing additional reforms formulated through detailed consultations involving lawyers, judges, and opposition figures. He stated that these progressive adjustments could ultimately serve as a catalyst for a successful democratic reset. Meanwhile, unrelated administrative notices indicated that the National Database and Registration Authority adjusted winter operating schedules for registration and mega centres across nine districts in Punjab, including Lahore and Gujranwala.

stories.title: Rana Irfan Wins Snooker World Cup After Defeating Muhammad Asif
stories.summary:
Pakistani cueist Rana Irfan captured the Snooker World Cup title by decisively defeating fellow compatriot and former world champion Muhammad Asif 5-0 in a one-sided final match held at the Active Oman Sports and Entertainment Hub in Oman. This victory marks Irfan's very first major international championship title. Hailing from Multan, Irfan totally controlled the title match, sweeping all five frames to prevent his highly experienced opponent from securing a single point throughout the contest.

Irfan set the tone early by taking the opening frame 96-46, backed by a strong break of 56, before widening his advantage with a 67-48 win in the second frame. He further solidified his command over the match by capturing the third frame 64-1. Demonstrating exceptional form, he produced a break of 68 to comfortably claim the fourth frame 91-12. He officially sealed the tournament victory by securing a 69-6 win in the fifth frame.

Pakistan put on a stellar overall performance at the tournament, sending all four participating athletes—Muhammad Asif, Rana Irfan, Asjad Iqbal, and Mubashir Raza—straight into the quarter-finals. Three of these competitors advanced to the semi-finals, ultimately setting up the all-Pakistan final showdown between Irfan and Asif. In a separate development, the National Database and Registration Authority announced revised winter working hours for registration and mega centres across nine Punjab districts.

stories.title: کراچی میں امریکی ہیلتھ کیئر فراڈ میں ملوث پانچ افراد گرفتار
stories.summary:
پاکستان کے شہر کراچی میں نیشنل سائبر کرائم ایجنسی نے کارروائی کرتے ہوئے پانچ ایسے افراد کو حراست میں لیا ہے جو امریکہ میں مقیم بزرگ شہریوں کے ساتھ طبی انشورنس کے مبینہ فراڈ میں ملوث بتائے جاتے ہیں۔ بدھ کے روز ان تمام مشتبہ افراد کو ایک مقامی عدالت میں پیش کیا گیا جہاں سے انہیں تفتیش کے لیے تین روزہ جسمانی ریمانڈ پر ادارے کے حوالے کر دیا گیا۔ جمعے کے روز انہیں دوبارہ عدالت میں پیش کیے جانے کا امکان ہے۔

اس معاملے پر گفتگو کرتے ہوئے این سی سی آئی اے کے ایڈیشنل ڈائریکٹر شہزاد اکبر نے بتایا کہ گرفتار کیے گئے تین اہم ملزمان کا تعلق میرپور خاص سے ہے اور انھی کی نشاندہی پر ضلع کے ایک چرچ کے احاطے میں کھڑی گاڑی سے پندرہ کروڑ روپے نقد برآمد کیے گئے ہیں۔ ابتدائی تحقیقات کے مطابق ملزمان یہ غیر قانونی سرگرمی سال 2020 سے جاری رکھے ہوئے تھے اور گزشتہ چار برسوں کے دوران ان کے تئیس بینک اکاؤنٹس میں ایک ارب بیس کروڑ روپے کی خطیر رقم منتقل ہو چکی ہے۔

تفتیش کاروں کے مطابق ملزمان کا یہ گروہ امریکہ میں بزرگ افراد کو ٹیلیفون پر پائیدار طبی آلات سے متعلق انشورنس مراعات کا جھانسہ دے کر ان کی نجی اور طبی معلومات حاصل کرتا تھا۔ یہ معلومات امریکہ میں موجود ایک بلنگ پارٹنر کو دی جاتی تھیں جو امریکی انشورنس کمپنیوں کو جعلی کلیمز بھیجتا تھا۔ کمیشن اور اخراجات کاٹنے کے بعد باقی رقم غیر قانونی حوالہ ہنڈی کے ذریعے پاکستان منتقل کی جاتی تھی جہاں اسے فرضی کمپنیوں کے اکاؤنٹس میں وصول کیا جاتا تھا۔

حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ اس گروہ کی کمپنی گلوبل ریسورس گروپ امریکی تحقیقاتی ادارے ایف بی آئی کے ریکارڈ کا بھی حصہ ہے اور اس سلسلے میں امریکی حکام سے بھی معلومات کا تبادلہ کیا گیا ہے۔ مزید برآں، ملزمان کے بائنانس اکاؤنٹ میں تقریبا چھ کروڑ روپے مالیت کی کرپٹو کرنسی بھی پائی گئی ہے۔ گرفتار شدہ افراد میں ایک کارپینٹر، ایک ٹیچر اور ایک بینکر شامل ہیں جنہوں نے دو سو سے زائد ملازمین رکھے ہوئے تھے۔

stories.title: Islamabad High Court Extends Suspension of Local Government Elections
stories.summary:
The Islamabad High Court has prolonged its freeze on local government polls within the federal capital for an additional two weeks. Justice Umair Majeed Malik presided over the session, directing the Election Commission of Pakistan to submit a thorough report regarding the dispute. This legal challenge stems from a petition filed by Amjad Ali, which questions the electoral framework and points out inconsistencies following the introduction of a new Local Government Ordinance in 2026 alongside a 2024 delimitation.

During the proceedings, Justice Malik questioned the election commission regarding unresolved boundaries, noting that multiple complainants remained uncertain about their designated electoral wards. The court emphasized that constituency delimitations must strictly adhere to the local government legislation enacted back in 2015. Although the ECP counsel argued that boundary delineations were completed properly per the applicable rules, the bench demanded clear satisfaction regarding the process.

Originally, the court intervened on November 13 by halting the election schedule and suspending an ECP notification dating back to October 21. The background of this administrative delay traces back to February 2021, when the term of the capital's previous elected local administration officially expired. Fresh voting rounds have since stalled due to numerous administrative hurdles and legal disputes.

This matter matters because statutory guidelines under Section 219(4) of the Elections Act, 2017, mandate that new local government elections must take place within 120 days after a term expires. The ongoing legal delays continue to postpone local representation in the capital territory, keeping governance structures in a state of prolonged limbo while the judiciary evaluates the statutory compliance of the election commission's operational framework.

stories.title: Bilawal Bhutto Zardari Calls for PTI Inclusion in National Political Reset
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari has described the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf as an undeniable political reality, asserting that any genuine political and democratic reset in Pakistan must incorporate the opposition party. Speaking at a 'Meet the Press' event at the Multan Press Club, Bilawal advocated for a new Charter of Democracy to tackle the nation's severe economic, political, and institutional challenges through parliamentary supremacy and stakeholder consensus. Although noting that PTI founder Imran Khan previously denied fundamental rights to rivals like President Asif Ali Zardari during his tenure, Bilawal insisted the party must participate in restructuring efforts.

As a confidence-building measure to bridge the trust gap between the ruling administration and the opposition, Bilawal proposed returning reserved seats to the PTI. He stressed that a systemic reset must rely on political and democratic channels rather than apolitical interventions, warning that decisions made outside Parliament weaken the legislature's effectiveness. He also underscored the necessity of robust electoral reforms, observing that past elections drew widespread criticism from both government figures and the opposition, which undermined the credibility of resulting governments. Addressing accountability issues, he criticized historical political persecutions and noted that economic pressures like inflation and rising energy costs require prioritizing citizens' struggles.

Furthermore, Bilawal touched upon several national topics, including expressing willingness to approach the prime minister to reverse Governor's Rule if an agreement with the PTI is reached, and condemning the house arrest of JUI-F chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman. He reiterated the PPP's support for establishing a South Punjab province strictly through constitutional procedures while avoiding ethnic fault lines, and emphasized protecting local governments, farmers, and labourers. Separately, upcoming regional events included a planned Makkah alliance meeting in Islamabad involving Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye.

stories.title: Bilawal Calls PTI a Political Reality and Urges System Trust
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari stated that the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf remains a crucial political reality whose confidence in the national system must be restored for any meaningful political reset to occur. Speaking at the Multan Press Club during his tour of Punjab, Bilawal addressed the polarized political climate surrounding former prime minister Imran Khan. While noting that views on Imran remain sharply divided between those who consider him a political prisoner and those who view him as a convicted felon, Bilawal stressed that PTI as a political party must be integrated back into parliamentary processes.

Addressing the ongoing national discourse regarding a system reset following recent governance challenges, Bilawal emphasized the need for goodwill gestures and confidence-building measures from the government toward the opposition. He pointed out that the disputed reserved seats from the 2024 elections present a straightforward opportunity to rebuild this lost trust. Although the PPP previously challenged court rulings that favored PTI, Bilawal argued that since PTI members ran under alternative arrangements, finding fair ways to address such parliamentary representation disputes is essential for restoring legitimacy to the electoral and judicial systems.

Bilawal also criticized the opposition for frequently boycotting essential legislative committees, such as finance and judicial panels, urging them to actively participate in parliamentary responsibilities instead of withholding cooperation. He maintained that sustainable solutions to poverty, inflation, and unemployment require the active engagement of all political entities within the legislature. Concluding his remarks, the PPP chairman reiterated that any reboot of the nation's governance framework must happen through transparent, democratic dialogue involving all stakeholders rather than extra-parliamentary decisions.

stories.title: Federal Government Suspends Former Local Government Secretary Over Karachi Collapse
stories.summary:
The federal government has suspended Waseem Shamshad, the former Local Government Secretary, from his duties for an initial period of 120 days with immediate effect following his removal related to the deadly Karachi Administration Employees Cooperative Housing Society building collapse. Issued via an official notification by the Establishment Division, the disciplinary action applies to Shamshad, who is a Grade-21 officer belonging to the Pakistan Administrative Service. In a separate administrative transfer notification, Police Service Group officer Asmatullah Junejo, a Grade-20 officer currently serving in the Federal Investigation Agency, was reassigned to Balochistan.

Authorities have taken active legal measures following the collapse of the six-storey building located in Karachi’s Baloch Colony Administrative Society, detaining five individuals thus far. Those detained by police include the building contractor and the brother of the owner, as nationwide and local raids continue to apprehend other responsible parties. Investigations into the disaster revealed grave construction irregularities, showing that the building plan was approved on March 10, 2026, under the name of Abdullah Shakeel for a residential plot meant only for a basement and a ground-plus-one structure.

According to official documents and sources, the six-storey structure was built illicitly within just eight months under the alleged protection of Sindh Building Control Authority officials, who permitted illegal additional floors in connivance with the builder. Meanwhile, the National Database and Registration Authority announced updated winter operating schedules for single-shift registration and mega centres across nine districts in Punjab, which include Lahore, Kasur, Nankana Sahib, Sheikhupura, Narowal, Gujranwala, Wazirabad, Sialkot, and Okara.

stories.title: سندھ بھر میں تمام غیر قانونی عمارتیں فوری بند کرنے کا حکم
stories.summary:
سندھ حکومت کی جانب سے صوبے بھر میں تمام غیر قانونی اور غیر مجاز تعمیرات کو فوری طور پر بند کروانے کے سخت احکامات جاری کر دیے گئے ہیں۔ سیکریٹری لوکل گورنمنٹ بلال احمد میمن کی جانب سے یہ ہدایات جاری کی گئی ہیں جن میں واضح کیا گیا ہے کہ بغیر منظوری یا منظور شدہ نقشے سے انحراف کر کے بنائی جانے والی تمام خالی عمارتوں کو گرا دیا جائے۔

حکومتی احکامات میں مزید ہدایت کی گئی ہے کہ اگر کسی مقام پر حکم امتناع بھی حاصل کیا گیا ہو تب بھی غیر قانونی تعمیرات کا سلسلہ فوری طور پر روکا جائے۔ اس نوعیت کے مقدمات میں قانونی معاونت کے لیے ایڈووکیٹ جنرل اور ڈسٹرکٹ اٹارنی سے مدد لینے کی بھی ہدایت جاری کی گئی ہے تاکہ قانونی تقاضے پورے کیے جا سکیں۔

ان غیر قانونی عمارتوں کے انہدام کے عمل کو شفاف اور منظم بنانے کے لیے باقاعدہ معیاری طریقہ کار یعنی ایس او پیز پر عملدرآمد کو یقینی بنانے کی ہدایت بھی کی گئی ہے۔ اس سارے عمل پر عملدرآمد کی تمام تر ذمہ داری ڈائریکٹر جنرل سندھ بلڈنگ کنٹرول اتھارٹی کے سپرد کی گئی ہے۔

یاد رہے کہ کراچی ایڈمنسٹریشن سوسائٹی میں ایک عمارت کے گرنے کے دلخراش واقعے کے بعد انتظامیہ پہلے ہی شہر بھر میں بغیر اجازت کے زیرِ تعمیر ایک سو تینتالیس عمارتوں کو سیل کر چکی ہے۔ صوبائی حکومت اس مسئلے کے حل کے لیے عدالتوں سے بھی جلد فیصلے کی استدعا کر رہی ہے۔

stories.title: اپوزیشن اتحاد کے ترجمان کا وزیراعظم ہاؤس جانے پر آمادگی کا اظہار
stories.summary:
تحریک تحفظ آئین پاکستان کے ترجمان اخوانزادہ حسین یوسفزئی نے ایک بیان میں کہا ہے کہ اپوزیشن لیڈر وزیراعظم ہاؤس اور رانا ثنا اللہ کی رہائش گاہ پر بھی بات چیت کے لیے جانے کو تیار ہیں۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ اگر وزیراعظم خود اپوزیشن لیڈر کے چیمبر میں تشریف لانا چاہیں تو ان کا خیرمقدم کیا جائے گا۔

ترجمان اپوزیشن اتحاد نے مزید واضح کیا کہ اگر رانا ثنا اللہ اپنا سابقہ موقف دوبارہ اپناتے ہیں تو وہ اس حوالے سے محمود خان اچکزئی کو آگاہ کریں گے۔ انہوں نے عزم ظاہر کیا کہ ان کا اتحاد حکومت کی طرح روزانہ اپنا بیان نہیں بدلتا اور ملکی بہتری کے لیے قومی سطح پر مکالمے اور اتفاق رائے کو ناگزیر سمجھتا ہے۔

محمود خان اچکزئی کی جانب سے پیش کردہ قومی حکومت کے فارمولے کا ذکر کرتے ہوئے ان کا کہنا تھا کہ پہلے مرحلے میں تمام اہم فریقین کو ایک میز پر بیٹھنا ہوگا۔ اس ابتدائی مرحلے میں سیاسی قیدیوں کی رہائی کے ساتھ ساتھ شفاف انتخابات کے انعقاد کے طریقہ کار کو حتمی شکل دی جائے گی۔

ترجمان نے کہا کہ مجوزہ قومی حکومت کا مقصد آئین میں کی جانے والی غیر آئینی ترامیم کو تبدیل کرنا اور آئندہ شفاف انتخابات کے انعقاد سے قبل ضروری انتخابی اصلاحات میں اپنا بھرپور کردار ادا کرنا ہوگا تاکہ ملک کو سیاسی بحران سے نکالا جا سکےَ

stories.title: پیٹرولیم مصنوعات کی قیمتوں میں اضافے پر عوام کو ٹارگٹڈ سبسڈی دی گئی، وزیراعظم
stories.summary:
وزیر اعظم شہباز شریف نے کہا ہے کہ عالمی سطح پر ایران اور امریکہ کے درمیان کشیدگی اور جنگ کے خطرات کے پیش نظر پیٹرولیم مصنوعات کی قیمتیں بڑھیں، جس کے اثرات سے عام آدمی کو بچانے کے لیے حکومت نے فوری طور پر ٹارگٹڈ سبسڈی کا اعلان کیا۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ اس ریلیف پیکج سے ملک بھر کے دو کروڑ افراد نے بھرپور فائدہ اٹھایا ہے۔

جماعت اسلامی کے ایک وفد سے ملاقات کے دوران گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیراعظم نے بتایا کہ حکومت نے اس مقصد کے لیے خطیر رقم خرچ کی ہے اور آٹھ سو سی سی تک کی گاڑیوں کو پیٹرول کی مد میں سبسڈی فراہم کی گئی ہے۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ اس معاملے پر اسحاق ڈار کی قیادت میں ایک ٹیم کام کر رہی ہے اور جماعت اسلامی کی تجاویز پر غور کے لیے خصوصی کمیٹی بھی تشکیل دے دی گئی ہے۔

دوسری جانب امیر جماعت اسلامی حافظ نعیم الرحمان نے تسلیم کیا کہ حکومت کی جانب سے پیٹرولیم قیمتوں پر کچھ ریلیف ضرور ملا ہے لیکن یہ تاحال ناکافی ہے۔ انہوں نے زور دیا کہ تیل کی قیمتیں بڑھنے سے ملک میں مہنگائی کا طوفان آتا ہے اس لیے عوام کو بجلی، آئی پی پیز اور دیگر شعبوں میں مزید ریلیف دینے کی ضرورت ہے۔

حافظ نعیم الرحمان نے یہ بھی بتایا کہ حکومت نے انہیں آگاہ کیا ہے کہ ریلیف کا دائرہ کار اب آٹھ سو سے بڑھا کر ایک ہزار سی سی گاڑیوں تک وسیع کر دیا گیا ہے۔ ملاقات میں دونوں رہنماؤں نے اس بات پر اتفاق کیا کہ عوام کو مہنگائی کے بوجھ سے نکالنے کے لیے مزید عملی اقدامات اٹھانے کی اشد ضرورت ہے۔

stories.title: Jamaat-e-Islami Urges Further Petroleum Levy Cuts Following Negotiations with Government
stories.summary:
Hafiz Naeemur Rehman, Ameer-e-Jamaat-e-Islami (JI) Pakistan, has urged the federal government to implement further reductions in the petroleum levy. Speaking outside the Prime Minister's House following a meeting with Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, Rehman noted that the levy had already decreased from Rs.80 to Rs.63 due to windfall levy impacts. He stated that JI conducted a peaceful campaign against the fee and that government and party committees successfully drafted a joint agreement to lower financial pressures on consumers.

The agreed petroleum relief package will expand to cover agricultural tractors, specifically for farmers owning up to 12.5 acres of land. It also includes rickshaws, Ching Chi three-wheelers, and automobiles with engine sizes ranging from 800cc to 1,000cc. Furthermore, the administration assured JI that officials would face restrictions on using vehicles with engines larger than 1,600cc, alongside broader plans to curtail state expenditures like free electricity and fuel privileges.

Regarding the power sector, Rehman stated that implementing agreements with independent power producers (IPPs) is projected to save Rs.4,500 billion, while annual capacity payments to IPPs must drop by Rs.300 billion to Rs.400 billion. He also asserted that JI's advocacy helped decrease electricity bills by 25 to 35 percent over the last two years. Additionally, the National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) announced revised winter schedules for mega and registration centres across nine Punjab districts, including Lahore, Kasur, and Gujranwala.

These measures matter as they reflect ongoing political negotiations aimed at easing severe inflation and utility cost burdens on citizens and agricultural workers in Pakistan. The discussions set a roadmap for upcoming budgetary policies and highlight collaborative efforts between political opposition groups and the federal government to address systemic economic grievances.

stories.title: Indian Rupee Declines Amid Rising Crude Oil Prices and Dollar Demand
stories.summary:
The Indian rupee dropped on Thursday, marking its second decline in three sessions for the week, pressured by rising global oil prices and a strong US dollar. The currency fluctuated between 92.65 and 92.33 before closing 0.2 percent lower at 92.4450 against the greenback. Brent crude climbed past $96 per barrel due to supply worries and security threats near the Strait of Hormuz, intensifying inflation and import cost concerns for India.

According to Amit Pabari, managing director of CR Forex, higher crude prices expand India's import bill and add downward pressure on the rupee, potentially capping its recent recovery. Analysts noted that while the 92.00 to 92.30 range serves as a strong support zone, consolidation and a potential recovery towards 93.00 to 93.50 are anticipated.
