During the clashes, protesters set fire to a police motorcycle in Gazipur, a primary garment manufacturing hub that has served as the center of ongoing labor unrest.

Mohammad Amjad Hossain, superintendent of Gazipur Industrial Police, stated that the situation has since returned to calm, though security forces remain on high alert. The fresh demonstrations erupted just a day after a government-appointed wage board approved a 36 percent increase in the minimum wage following nearly 12 hours of negotiations. Labor rights advocates noted this increase is the smallest in four decades and failed to satisfy workers who had called for the wage to be doubled.

The ongoing protests are significant because they have shuttered factories, blocked highways, and disrupted production in a vital economic sector employing over four million people in a country of approximately 175 million. These labor tensions, combined with separate political instabilities surrounding former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, heighten concerns of broader unrest in the world's second-largest garment exporter.

stories.title: JUI-F Chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman Barred From Sargodha District for 30 Days
stories.summary:
Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman and eight other party leaders have been barred from entering, residing, or remaining in the Sargodha district for 30 days. The restriction was issued on November 25 by the Sargodha deputy commissioner under the Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance ahead of a planned party rally on November 26. The notification cited a district police officer's report describing the leaders as firebrand speakers with a history of delivering provocative speeches that threaten public order.

Alongside Fazlur Rehman, the order names eight other figures: Maulana Naseer Ahmad Abrar, Maulana Amjad Khan, Prof Ghazanfar Aziz, Maulana Safi Ullah, Maulana Muhammad Noor Khan Hans, Maulana Muhammad Zakria Shah, Maulana Muhammad Yahya Abbasi, and Maulana Jamal Abdul Nasir. Meanwhile, police detained several senior JUI-F leaders in Sargodha and Khushab districts for allegedly violating Section 144, while party workers faced road blockades and arrests across Punjab.

Maulana Fazlur Rehman condemned the restrictions in a video message, demanding the immediate release of detained members and the protection of civil liberties. The ban escalates existing political tensions between JUI-F and the central government, which have grown following disputes over governor's rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and the withdrawal of security details from Fazl's residences. PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari has expressed support for Fazl, criticizing the government's recent actions against him.

stories.title: Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari emphasizes political reset and truth-telling by politicians in Pakistan
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari advocated for a democratic political reset during a visit to Punjab, speaking at the Multan Press Club. Bilawal stated that politicians bear the responsibility of telling the public the truth and that restoring trust in institutions requires including all political stakeholders, such as the ruling party, allies, and the opposition. He emphasized that the parliament must be the sole venue for decisions to help the country overcome economic hardships and foreign difficulties.

During his remarks, the PPP chairman expressed regret that current political discussions in the cabinet, parliament, and television talk shows neglect the fundamental struggles of everyday citizens. He noted that the public faces severe distress regarding basic necessities, managing food, educating children, and securing medicines for elders. Furthermore, he highlighted that farmers and labourers are failing to receive fair compensation for their hard work, and youth suffer from widespread unemployment and financial strain.

Bilawal's comments follow an ongoing national debate regarding a system reset in Pakistan. Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi previously called for new administrative units and a system reset in July by arguing that governance had collapsed. In contrast, Bilawal asserted in a November 17 speech that the system was deliberately made to collapse, while consistently urging the restoration of parliamentary supremacy and public trust in the judiciary and electoral processes.

Political stability and institutional trust are crucial for addressing Pakistan's compounding economic and administrative challenges. Bilawal's ongoing tour across Punjab, including stops in Multan, Dera Ghazi Khan, and Muzaffargarh, aims to build consensus among political parties. By prioritizing public economic burdens and legislative authority, the PPP leadership seeks to address the widespread restlessness among the workforce and younger generations.

stories.title: Gold Prices Surge Across Domestic and International Markets
stories.summary:
Gold prices experienced a significant increase in Pakistan on Thursday, according to the All Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Association. The cost of one tola of gold rose by Rs4,700, bringing the total to Rs378,636. Additionally, the price of 10 grams of gold increased by Rs4,030, reaching a total of Rs324,619.

In the global market, gold prices saw a parallel upward movement, climbing by $47 to reach $3,561 per ounce. Along with precious yellow metal, the domestic market also witnessed a price hike for silver, which increased by Rs166 per tola to settle at Rs4,629.

Gold is historically viewed by investors as a safe-haven asset, frequently attracting capital during periods marked by high inflation, geopolitical instability, and broader economic uncertainty. Because it has served as a reliable store of wealth for centuries, demand typically rises when participants seek alternatives to traditional financial instruments.

Pakistan calculates its domestic gold pricing using a revised mechanism that adds a premium of $20 per ounce over prevailing international market rates. Meanwhile, separate reports from Reuters indicated that robust domestic demand is driving inflationary pressures within the United States, where underlying price metrics for October recorded their largest year-on-year increase since late 2023.

stories.title: مکہ دفاعی معاہدے کے تحت پاکستان، سعودی عرب اور ترکیہ کا اجلاس اسلام آباد میں ہوگا
stories.summary:
مکہ مشترکہ دفاعی معاہدے کے تحت پاکستان، سعودی عرب اور ترکیہ کے درمیان اہم مذاکرات ستائیس اور اٹھائیس نومبر کو اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوں گے۔ اس اعلیٰ سطح کے اجلاس میں تینوں ممالک کے سیاسی اور عسکری وفود شرکت کر رہے ہیں۔ اجلاس کا مقصد دفاعی تعاون کا فروغ، علاقائی سلامتی کی صورت حال کا جائزہ لینا اور مشترکہ دفاعی حکمت عملی بنانا ہے۔

ذرائع کے مطابق سعودی عرب کی نمائندگی وزیر خارجہ فیصل بن فرحان اور وزیر دفاع خالد بن سلمان کریں گے جبکہ ترکیہ کی جانب سے وزیر خارجہ حاقان فیدان اور وزیر دفاع یاشار گولر شریک ہوں گے۔ پاکستان کی طرف سے نائب وزیراعظم و وزیر خارجہ اسحاق ڈار، وزیر دفاع خواجہ آصف اور اعلیٰ عسکری حکام ان مذاکرات میں حصہ لیں گے۔

اجلاس کے انتظامات اور غیرملکی وفود کی آمدورفت کے پیش نظر اسلام آباد پولیس نے ٹریفک ایڈوائزری جاری کی ہے۔ ایکسپریس ہائی وے اور سری نگر ہائی وے پر مختلف اوقات میں ٹریفک ڈائیورشنز ہوں گی جبکہ شہریوں کو متبادل راستے استعمال کرنے اور سفر کے لیے اضافی وقت رکھنے کی ہدایت کی گئی ہے۔

یہ مذاکرات خطے میں امن اور استحکام کے فروغ کے ساتھ ساتھ برادر ممالک کے درمیان دفاعی شراکت داری کو مزید مستحکم کرنے کیلیے انتہائی اہمیت کے حامل ہیں۔ جمعرات کے روز ہونے والے کمیٹی اجلاس میں اس دو روزہ کانفرنس کا ایجنڈا پہلے ہی طے کیا جاچکا ہے۔

stories.title: اوگرا نے پیٹرول اور ڈیزل کی قیمتوں میں کمی کا نوٹیفیکیشن جاری کردیا
stories.summary:
آئل اینڈ گیس ریگولیٹری اتھارٹی نے ستائیس نومبر کے لیے پیٹرولیم مصنوعات کی قیمتوں میں مزید کمی کا باضابطہ نوٹیفیکیشن جاری کر دیا ہے۔ حکومت کے منظور کردہ پرائسنگ میکنزم کے تحت کی جانے والی اس ردوبدل کا اطلاق رات بارہ بجے سے ہو گیا ہے۔

نئے نوٹیفیکیشن کے مطابق پیٹرول کی فی لیٹر قیمت میں ایک روپیہ کمی کی گئی ہے جس کے بعد پیٹرول کی نئی قیمت تین سو تیرہ روپے فی لیٹر ہو گئی ہے۔ اس کمی سے عام صارفین کو جزوی ریلیف ملے گا۔

اسی طرح ہائی اسپیڈ ڈیزل کی فی لیٹر قیمت میں دو روپے کی کمی کی گئی ہے، جس کے بعد ڈیزل کی قیمت کم ہو کر تین سو چھتالیس روپے فی لیٹر کی سطح پر پہنچ گئی ہے۔ قیمتوں میں اس معمولی کمی سے ٹرانسپورٹ کے شعبے پر بھی اثرات مرتب ہوں گے۔

حکومت کی جانب سے کی جانے والی یہ قیمتوں میں ردوبدل وفاقی حکومت کے منظور شدہ طریقہ کار کے تحت عمل میں لائی گئی ہے۔ اوگرا کی طرف سے جاری کردہ یہ نرخ آج کے دن کے لیے نافذ العمل ہوں گے۔

stories.title: سائنس دانوں نے تمباکو کے پودے میں کینسر کی اہم دوا تیار کرلی
stories.summary:
ماہرینِ نفسیات اور سائنس دانوں نے تمباکو کی ایک مخصوص قسم نیکوٹیانا بینتھامیانا کا استعمال کرتے ہوئے کینسر کے علاج میں استعمال ہونے والی اہم دوا پیسلی ٹیکسل کا مکمل حیاتیاتی عمل تیار کر لیا ہے۔ ٹیکسال کے نام سے جانی جانے والی اس دوا کی تیاری میں یہ کامیابی قدرتی ذرائع اور بالخصوص یو کے درختوں پر انحصار کم کرنے میں مددگار ثابت ہوگی۔

یہ تحقیق تئیس نومبر کو سائنسی جریدے نیچر کیمیکل بائیولوجی میں شائع ہوئی جس کی قیادت یونیورسٹی آف کوپن ہیگن کے سوٹیریوس کامپرانیس نے کی، جبکہ اس میں یونیورسٹی آف ایتھنز اور فیوم یونیورسٹی کے محققین بھی شامل تھے۔ پیسلی ٹیکسل کی پیچیدہ ساخت اور محدود دستیابی کے باعث اس کی تیاری مشکل رہی ہے، لیکن اس نئی تحقیق میں پہلی بار پورے عمل کو ایک ساتھ تشکیل دیا گیا ہے۔

تحقیق کے دوران ماہرین نے خلیے کے مختلف حصوں جیسے پلاسٹڈز، اینڈوپلازمک ریٹیکیولم، سائٹوپلازم اور پیروکسی سومز کے درمیان کیمیائی مرکبات کی منتقلی کا جائزہ لیا۔ مخصوص جینیاتی اور حیاتیاتی طریقے اپناتے ہوئے سائنس دانوں نے اس دوا کی پیداوار کو پانچ سو گنا سے زائد بڑھایا، جس کے نتیجے میں ایک گرام خشک پودے سے اکسٹھ اعشاریہ صفر پانچ مائیکروگرام دوا حاصل ہوئی۔

ماہرین کے نزدیک یہ پیش رفت ادویات کی تیاری کے لیے متبادل ذریعہ فراہم کرتی ہے، تاہم تجارتی پیمانے پر اس کے استعمال سے پہلے مزید جانچ کی ضرورت ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistan Lowers Petrol and Diesel Prices for November 27
stories.summary:
The federal government announced a reduction in the prices of petrol and high-speed diesel for November 27. According to an Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority press release, petrol decreased by Re1 to cost Rs313 per litre, while high-speed diesel dropped by Rs2 to Rs346 per litre.

This latest revision follows a previous price decrease enacted for November 26, which saw petrol and diesel fall by Rs4 and Rs5 per litre, respectively. The adjustments form part of a daily pricing mechanism implemented on July 17 to address continuous global oil market volatility driven by renewed tensions between the United States and Iran.

To mitigate the impact of rising fuel costs on vulnerable populations, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif previously introduced targeted relief initiatives. These included a special scheme offering discounted fuel to users of motorcycles, rickshaws, and small cars, alongside broader national austerity measures such as early closing times for commercial markets.

Earlier in November, the government also arranged for domestic oil refineries to absorb financial burdens to keep domestic petrol prices lower than prevailing global rates. The ongoing daily revisions reflect active state management amid fluctuating international petroleum markets and broader regional supply concerns.

The regular price updates are intended to pass international market adjustments directly to local consumers while maintaining structured oversight. Regulatory bodies will continue reviewing rates daily to navigate ongoing economic pressures affecting the energy sector.

stories.title: Ireland Cricket Team Scheduled for Historic Tour of Pakistan
stories.summary:
Ireland's men's cricket team is set to tour Pakistan for the very first time in January, featuring in three one-day international matches hosted in Lahore. According to Pakistan Cricket Board officials, the upcoming series serves as crucial preparation for the team ahead of the World Cup qualifiers.

The tour itinerary includes a total of six white-ball matches in Lahore starting January 9. Before the official international fixtures, Ireland will play a three-match one-day series against the Pakistan Shaheens from January 13 to 17. Following those warm-up matches, the three official ODIs against the main Pakistan team are scheduled for January 20, 22, and 24.

This upcoming visit follows a postponement from August of the previous year, when Ireland's scheduled tour involving Test and ODI matches had to be delayed due to a congested international calendar for the hosts. Cricket Ireland and the PCB subsequently agreed to focus the rescheduled visit exclusively on the 50-over format to aid preparation for the next year's World Cup.

The 50-over World Cup is scheduled to be jointly hosted by South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Namibia. Ireland will use the Pakistan series to fine-tune their squad before participating in a 10-team qualifying tournament taking place in South Africa and Namibia from February 26 to March 21.

stories.title: Pakistan and Maldives Explore Direct Flights and Maritime Links to Boost Trade
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Commerce Jam Kamal Khan and Maldives Minister of Tourism and Civil Aviation Mohamed Saeed held high-level discussions regarding the establishment of direct flights between Pakistan and the Maldives by May 2027. The talks also focused on expanding cooperation across trade, investment, tourism, and maritime connectivity during a meeting at the Karachi Expo Centre.

The Maldivian delegation indicated that May 2027 is the targeted timeframe for launching direct air links, pending the completion of necessary logistical arrangements. The chief executive of the Maldivian national airline also participated in the meeting. Jam Kamal welcomed the initiative, noting that direct air connectivity paired with commercially viable shipping services would significantly enhance business exchanges and bilateral trade.

Building upon the recent visit of the Maldivian president to Pakistan, Jam Kamal reaffirmed Islamabad's dedication to serving as a reliable long-term economic partner. He emphasized export opportunities for Pakistani agricultural products, pharmaceuticals, textiles, leather, and construction materials, provided they meet the standards of the Maldivian hospitality industry. Furthermore, both nations explored investment opportunities in halal tourism, Shariah-compliant resort development, and medical tourism.

The discussions also addressed potential healthcare partnerships, with the Maldivian side noting a high demand for skilled medical professionals and hospitality workers, alongside plans to introduce training hotels. Additionally, the commerce minister highlighted prospects for establishing maritime networks connecting Pakistan with the Maldives and East African markets, including Tanzania.

stories.title: مکہ دفاعی معاہدے کے تحت سعودی عرب کا خطرہ ہمارا خطرہ ہے، خواجہ آصف
stories.summary:
وزیر دفاع خواجہ آصف نے تصدیق کی ہے کہ اسلام آباد میں ہونے والے مکہ دفاعی معاہدے کے ارکان کے اہم اجلاس میں سعودی عرب اور یمن کے حوثیوں کے تنازع پر مشاورت کی جائے گی۔ اے ایف پی کو دیے گئے انٹرویو میں انہوں نے سعودی حکمت عملی کی تعریف کی اور واضح کیا کہ معاہدے کے تحت سعودی عرب کے لیے کوئی بھی خطرہ پاکستان اور ترکیہ کے لیے بھی خطرہ ہے۔

مشرق وسطیٰ میں امریکہ اور ایران کے درمیان کشیدگی کے تناظر میں انہوں نے کہا کہ مکہ دفاعی معاہدہ ابھی ابتدائی مرحلے میں ہے۔ تمام انتظامات کو حتمی شکل دینے اور اقدامات طے کرنے کے لیے آئندہ چند ماہ میں مسلسل مشاورت کی ضرورت ہوگی تاکہ باضابطہ امور کو آگے بڑھایا جا سکے۔

ایران کی جانب سے براہ راست حملے کے امکانی ردعمل پر بات کرنے سے گریز کرتے ہوئے خواجہ آصف نے اسرائیل کو خطے کے دیگر ممالک کے لیے خطرہ قرار دیا اور خطے کے ممالک پر زور دیا کہ وہ متحد ہو کر اپنی صفیں مضبوط کریں۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر بھی روشنی ڈالی کہ اسرائیل کی جانب سے مزید جارحیت کا امکان موجود ہے۔

وزیر دفاع نے یاد دلایا کہ پاکستان نے اس سے قبل امریکہ اور ایران کے درمیان ثالثی کا کردار ادا کیا تھا جس کے نتیجے میں رواں برس جون میں دونوں ممالک نے معاہدے پر دستخط کیے اور مختصر عرصے کے لیے جنگ روکی تھی، جس میں آبنائے ہرمز کی بحالی اور جوہری پروگرام پر مذاکرات شامل تھے۔

stories.title: Pakistan International Airlines Resumes Normal United Kingdom Flight Operations
stories.summary:
Pakistan International Airlines announced the full restoration of its flight schedule between Pakistan and the United Kingdom. The normalization follows an unexpected disruption caused by its wet-lease partner, Norse Atlantic, which abruptly halted its operations just as passengers were preparing to board flights in London and Manchester.

The sudden grounding occurred after Norse Atlantic declared its financial standing to be critical, citing an urgent requirement for fresh financing to address short-term liquidity challenges. The carrier's sudden announcement caught both travelers and partner airlines off guard, leading to the cancellation of flights such as London Heathrow to Islamabad flight PK786 and Manchester to Lahore flight PK710.

In response to the crisis, Pakistan International Airlines implemented a contingency framework by shifting its United Kingdom routes directly onto its own widebody Boeing 777 fleet. Scheduled services resumed operating on time following the transition. Company representatives noted that affected travelers received assistance, were rebooked onto alternative flights based on individual preferences, or were provided with full, penalty-free refunds if they chose to alter or defer their journeys.

The national carrier criticized the partner airline's abrupt suspension without prior warning as deeply regrettable, stating that it is actively pursuing the matter at the highest executive and contractual levels. Background details indicate that Pakistan International Airlines was privatized in December through an auction where a consortium led by Arif Habib Corporation Limited secured a 75 percent stake for Rs135 billion. Previously, in October, the airline had secured an ACMI lease agreement with Norse Atlantic Airways for two Boeing 787-9 Dreamliners to expand its fleet for rising demand.

stories.title: Apple Removes MiniMax Chatbot App Talkie Following Child Safety Concerns
stories.summary:
Apple removed the popular chatbot app Talkie, developed by Shanghai-based MiniMax, from its App Store worldwide. The global removal this week followed media reports by ABC News and the Bureau of Investigative Journalism revealing that the application's AI-generated characters delivered sexually inappropriate and abusive messages to minors. Launched in 2023, Talkie provides users with romantic AI companions and holds an 18+ rating, with age restrictions preventing sign-ups for children under 14 or 16 depending on the country. However, child safety advocates raised concerns regarding weak verification safeguards that rely on users self-reporting their age. 

Talkie is multilingual and holds particular popularity in the United States, Mexico, and the Philippines, according to research firm Sensor Tower. Unlike typical large language model assistants like ChatGPT or Gemini, AI companions focus on sustained emotional engagement and human-like interactions. The app, alongside its Chinese counterpart Xingye, served as a primary revenue generator for MiniMax, accounting for over 60% of the company's income in 2024 before the firm ceased reporting chatbot-related revenue shares. By October 2026, Chinese research firm Unique reported that Talkie maintained roughly 11 million monthly active users across its website and app.

The action against MiniMax coincides with mounting global scrutiny over artificial intelligence chatbots and interactions with minors. Governments previously criticized Elon Musk’s Grok AI for generating sexualized images of women and children, while Character.AI faces multiple US lawsuits over inappropriate minor interactions. In July, Chinese authorities cracked down on domestic AI companions like Xingye, prohibiting intimate relationships for minors and mandating strict guardrails against emotional dependency and addiction. These regulations prompted companies like ByteDance and Alibaba to disable humanlike interactive agents, though the restrictions sparked backlash from users attached to virtual characters. Following its Hong Kong IPO in January, MiniMax shifted its primary focus toward multimodal AI models and enterprise coding.

stories.title: Nepal Starts Legal Process to Declare Thousands Missing from Floods Dead
stories.summary:
Nepal initiated legal procedures to formally declare thousands of individuals missing since catastrophic summer floods as dead, three months after the initial disaster. The disaster struck on August 26 when a high-altitude glacier on the border between Nepal and China collapsed, sending a massive wall of water, ice, rock, and debris downstream. The resulting floods claimed over 1,400 lives in Nepal and left more than 5,500 people missing. Ram Bahadur KC, spokesman for the disaster management authority, confirmed that officials started the verification process to declare the missing individuals dead.

To facilitate the declarations, authorities published public notices listing approximately 4,000 missing individuals, which includes 623 foreign nationals, inviting corrections or objections before formal actions take place. Additional names may be included following further verification, with official death declarations expected once legal steps conclude. This effort follows a legal amendment enacted last month that shortened the mandatory waiting period for declaring disaster victims dead from 12 years down to roughly six weeks. The flood stands as one of the most severe disasters in the history of the Himalayan nation.

Despite extensive weeks-long rescue operations featuring hundreds of personnel searching through thick mud and debris, only a handful of missing people were located alive, and just 112 bodies have been identified and returned to families. The lack of formal death certificates prevented many relatives from claiming compensation, transferring property, or addressing legal matters, leading some families to conduct symbolic cremations. Meanwhile, across the border in Tibet, Chinese state media reported 43 deaths and 519 missing persons in September, though Beijing has provided no recent updates when queried by journalists.

stories.title: Bangladesh Garment Workers Clash with Police Despite Minimum Wage Increase
stories.summary:
Bangladesh garment workers clashed with police forces on Thursday, just a day after securing a 36-percent minimum wage increase following weeks of demonstrations that severely impacted production in the critical export sector. Protesters gathered in groups to march and block roads within the industrial zone of Gazipur, located near the capital city of Dhaka. Police responded by deploying tear gas and stun grenades to disperse the crowds. Israil Hawladar, chief of the police specialized industrial unit, stated that the unrest was restricted to two primary areas and that the situation was brought under control.

Police reported that conditions elsewhere in the country remained relatively calm, with factories operating normally in another major garment hub, Narayanganj, while only a small number of workers stayed away from facilities in Savar. Bangladesh ranks as the world's second-largest garment exporter behind China. The recent labor agreement, reached on Wednesday and slated to take effect in January, raises the minimum monthly wage from 12,500 taka to 17,000 taka, or approximately $136. Workers had initially demanded a monthly minimum of 30,000 taka to counter surging costs for food, housing, healthcare, and transportation.

The garment sector serves as the economic backbone of Bangladesh, generating roughly four-fifths of the nation's export earnings and employing upwards of four million people to supply consumers across North America and Europe. Labor Minister Ariful Haque Chowdhury urged workers to prioritize industrial competitiveness and pursue dialogue rather than impulsive protests when addressing future concerns. The Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association reported that recent protests generated an estimated $428 million in industry losses, while orders valued at $254 million shifted to alternative countries.

stories.title: واٹس ایپ نے صارفین کے لیے میسجز شیڈول کرنے کا نیا فیچر متعارف کرا دیا
stories.summary:
مقبول ترین میسجنگ ایپ واٹس ایپ نے اپنے صارفین کی طویل عرصے سے چلی آنے والی خواہش کو پورا کرتے ہوئے پیغامات کو شیڈول کرنے کی سہولت متعارف کرانے کا باضابطہ اعلان کر دیا ہے۔ اس نئی تبدیلی کے بعد اب صارفین کسی بھی پیغام کو فوری طور پر بھیجنے کی بجائے اس کے پہنچنے کی تاریخ اور وقت کا تعین پہلے سے ہی کر سکیں گے، جس کے نتیجے میں مطلوبہ پیغام مقررہ وقت پر خود بخود متعلقہ چیٹ میں منتقل ہو جائے گا۔ میٹا کے زیرِ انتظام چلنے والی اس ایپ میں اس سے قبل یہ سہولت فراہم نہیں کی گئی تھی، لیکن اب آنے والے اس فیچر کے ذریعے اکیلے افراد کی چیٹس اور گروپس دونوں میں ہی پیغامات کا شیڈول تیار کرنا ممکن ہو گا۔ اس سہولت کے دائرہ کار میں صرف سادہ الفاظ یا تحریریں ہی نہیں بلکہ مختلف ویب لنکس، تصاویر اور ویڈیوز بھی شامل ہوں گی۔

نئے فیچر کو استعمال کرنے کا طریقہ انتہائی آسان بنایا گیا ہے تاکہ ہر فرد اسے آسانی سے برت سکے۔ صارف کو سب سے پہلے اپنا مطلوبہ پیغام تحریر کرنا ہوگا اور پھر معمول کے مطابق سینڈ کا بٹن دبانے کی بجائے اس نشان کو کچھ دیر تک دبا کر رکھنا پڑے گا۔ اس عمل کے بعد سکرین پر ایک نئی ونڈو ظاہر ہو گی جہاں سے اس پیغام کو بھیجے جانے کے لیے مطلوبہ تاریخ اور وقت کا انتخاب کیا جا سکے گا۔ جیسے ہی وہ مقررہ وقت آئے گا، پیغام خود بخود آگے روانہ ہو جائے گا۔ صارفین اپنی چیٹ کی معلومات والی سکرین میں جا کر ان تمام پیغامات کو دیکھ بھی سکیں گے جنہیں انہوں نے شیڈول کیا ہوگا، اور ضرورت پڑنے پر وہ ان پیغامات کو حذف کرنے کا اختیار بھی رکھتے ہوں گے۔

موجودہ تفصیلات کے مطابق اس فیچر کے تحت کسی بھی پیغام کے بھیجنے کا وقت موجودہ وقت سے کم از کم 10 منٹ آگے اور زیادہ سے زیادہ دو ہفتے کے فاصلے تک مقرر کیا جا سکتا ہے۔ تاہم یہ کارآمد سہولت ہر صارف کو فی الفور میسر نہیں آئے گی۔ اگر سینڈ کے آئیکون کو دبا کر رکھنے کے باوجود شیڈولنگ کا کوئی بھی متبادل نظر نہ آئے تو اس کی بنیادی وجہ یہ ہو گی کہ یہ فیچر تاحال اس مخصوص اکاؤنٹ تک نہیں پہنچ سکا ہے۔ کمپنی کی جانب سے فراہم کردہ معلومات کے مطابق اس فیچر کی دنیا بھر میں فراہمی کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے اور آنے والے چند ہفتوں کے اندر اندر اسے تمام صارفین کے لیے مہیا کر دیا جائے گا۔

stories.title: بنگلہ دیشی پارلیمنٹ کے سپیکر حافظ الدین احمد کا چھ روزہ سرکاری دورہ پاکستان
stories.summary:
بنگلہ دیشی پارلیمنٹ کے سپیکر حافظ الدین احمد قومی اسمبلی کے سپیکر سردار ایاز صادق کی دعوت پر چھ روزہ سرکاری دورے پر اسلام آباد میں موجود ہیں۔ ان کا یہ دورہ 23 نومبر سے شروع ہوا اور 29 نومبر تک متوقع ہے، جو کہ کسی بھی بنگلہ دیشی سپیکر کا پہلا سرکاری دورہ ہے۔

دورے کے دوران حافظ الدین احمد نے وزیراعظم شہباز شریف اور صدر آصف علی زرداری سے ملاقات کی۔ ملاقاتوں میں دوطرفہ تعلقات کو فروغ دینے، پارلیمانی تعاون اور تجارت سمیت مختلف شعبوں میں روابط بڑھانے پر اتفاق کیا گیا۔ پاکستان ہائی کمیشن کے مطابق، اسلام آباد بنگلہ دیش کی درخواست پر شوگر ملوں کی بحالی کے لیے تکنیکی مہارت فراہم کرنے کے لیے تیار ہے۔

اسلام آباد میں صحافیوں سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے حافظ الدین نے 1971 کے واقعات کو یاد کیا اور دعویٰ کیا کہ اس وقت انڈیا نے بنگالیوں کی مدد نہیں کی بلکہ پاکستان کو کمزور کیا۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ دونوں ممالک کے درمیان پارلیمانی نظام ایک جیسا ہے اور مسئلہ کشمیر اقوام متحدہ کی قراردادوں کے مطابق حل ہونا چاہیے۔ انہوں نے یہ بھی کہا کہ سابق وزیرِ اعظم شیخ حسینہ واجد کو واپس آنے پر جیل جانا پڑے گا۔

حافظ الدین احمد ایک سابق پاکستانی فوجی کپتان ہیں جنھوں نے 1971 کی جنگ میں حصہ لیا تھا اور بعد میں بنگلہ دیش کا تیسرا بڑا فوجی اعزاز 'بیر بکرم' حاصل کیا۔ انہوں نے پاکستان ملٹری اکیڈمی (پی ایم اے) کاکول کا بھی دورہ کیا جہاں اکیڈمی کے کمانڈنٹ لیفٹیننٹ جنرل افتخار حسن چوہدری نے ان کا استقبال کیا۔ وفد میں حمام چوہدری بھی شامل ہیں جن کے دادا ماضی میں پاکستان کی قومی اسمبلی کے سپیکر رہ چکے ہیں۔

stories.title: ایران اور امریکا کے درمیان کشیدگی کم کرنے کیلیے پاکستان کی ثالثی جاری
stories.summary:
ایرانی وزیر خارجہ عباس عراقچی نے تصدیق کی ہے کہ ایران اور امریکا کے درمیان کشیدگی کم کرنے اور جنگ بندی کے لیے پاکستان اور قطر کی سفارتی کوششیں تاحال جاری ہیں۔ انہوں نے یہ بیان اپنے ٹیلی گرام چینل پر جاری کردہ ایک ویڈیو پیغام میں دیا۔

عباس عراقچی کے مطابق، پاکستان اور قطر جیسے برادر مسلم ممالک اس وقت بھی تہران اور واشنگٹن کے درمیان تجاویز اور پیغامات پہنچانے کا فریضہ انجام دے رہے ہیں۔ جنگ بندی کے لیے مختلف تجاویز سامنے آئی ہیں جن کا جائزہ لیا جا رہا ہے تاکہ کسی ممکنہ حل تک پہنچا جا سکے۔

ایرانی وزیر خارجہ نے واضح کیا کہ ان تجاویز کے باوجود ایران کے بنیادی مؤقف میں کوئی تبدیلی واقع نہیں ہوئی ہے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ آبنائے ہرمز کو کھولنے کے لیے ایران کے تمام مطالبات کا پورا ہونا لازمی شرط ہے۔

مشرق وسطیٰ میں جاری جنگ اور آبنائے ہرمز کی بندش کی وجہ سے عالمی سطح پر بحری تجارت اور توانائی کی ترسیل شدید متاثر ہوئی ہے۔ واضح رہے کہ رواں سال جون میں بھی پاکستان کی ثالثی کی بدولت امریکا اور ایران کے درمیان مختصر مدت کے لیے جنگ بندی ہوئی تھی اگرچہ وہ چند روز بعد ختم ہو گئی تھی۔

stories.title: اسرائیل میں نئی حکومت کی تشکیل کا معاہدہ طے، نیتن یاہو کو بڑا دھچکا
stories.summary:
اسرائیل کے سابق فوجی سربراہ گادی آئزنکوٹ کی جماعت یاشار اور یائر گولان کی ڈیموکریٹس پارٹی کے درمیان نئی حکومت کی تشکیل کے لیے ایک اہم اتحادی معاہدہ طے پا گیا ہے۔ اس معاہدے کے طے پانے کے بعد وزیراعظم بنجمن نیتن یاہو کے لیے نئی حکومت بنانا انتہائی مشکل ہو گیا ہے۔

ٹائمز آف اسرائیل کے مطابق، اس معاہدے کا باضابطہ اعلان دونوں فریقوں کے درمیان مذاکرات کی بحالی کے چند گھنٹوں بعد ایک مشترکہ بیان میں کیا گیا۔ معاہدے کی رو سے بائیں بازو کی جماعت ڈیموکریٹس کو کل چار وزارتیں دی جائیں گی، جن میں قومی سلامتی، محنت و بہبود، مواصلات، اور ثقافت و کھیل کے محکمے شامل ہیں۔

معاہدے کے تحت محنت اور وزارتِ بہبود کو یکجا کرنے کی تجویز ہے جبکہ ڈیموکریٹس کو سماجی مساوات کی وزارت کی نگرانی بھی سونپی جائے گی۔ البتہ انہیں وزارتِ تعلیم اور وزارتِ انصاف کے عہدے حاصل کرنے میں کامیابی نہیں ملی، حالانکہ وہ ان کے حصول کی کوشش کر رہے تھے۔

اس کے متبادل کے طور پر ڈیموکریٹس کو پارلیمان کی آئینی، قانونی اور عدالتی امور کی کمیٹی کی سربراہی اور ججوں کے تقرر سے متعلق کمیٹی میں نمائندگی دی جائے گی۔ اس معاہدے میں عدالتی اصلاحات کو مکمل طور پر ختم کرنے اور عدلیہ کی آزادی کے تحفظ کی واضح یقین دہانی بھی شامل کی گئی ہے۔

stories.title: Israeli Airstrikes in Gaza Kill Nine, Including Hamas-Appointed Education Minister
stories.summary:
Israeli airstrikes and gunfire resulted in the deaths of at least nine Palestinians across Gaza overnight, marking a third consecutive night of military attacks despite an existing ceasefire. Medics reported that an airstrike targeted an apartment in Deir Al-Balah in central Gaza, killing Khaled Abu Nada, the Hamas-appointed deputy minister of education, alongside his wife. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed the attack formed part of an ongoing series of targeted operations against Hamas members, noting that approximately 80 members had been killed over the past month. Abu Nada represented the third senior Hamas official killed since Tuesday.

The Israeli military stated that Abu Nada managed the economic portfolio for Hamas, overseeing banking and investment networks that funded group activities and force buildup, which they argued would hinder the group's financial sustainability and military capabilities. Hamas verified Abu Nada's death and his role within its political office, condemning the assassination of academics and civilian figures as a heinous crime and a violation of the Gaza ceasefire agreement and international law. Hamas placed political and moral responsibility on US President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace for failing to halt the attacks.

Additional overnight airstrikes in Gaza City resulted in six deaths in the Tuffah neighborhood and the Beach refugee camp. Later on Thursday, medics reported that Israeli gunfire killed a 62-year-old man in the eastern Bureij refugee camp, an incident the Israeli military stated it was unaware of. The broader ceasefire plan backed by Trump has failed to stop the violence or achieve Hamas' disarmament. According to respective tallies, at least 1,600 Palestinians and five Israeli soldiers have died since the October 2025 ceasefire. Overall, the conflict has killed over 74,000 Palestinians since 2023, displaced the entirety of Gaza's population, triggered a hunger crisis, and drawn assessments of genocide from scholars and a United Nations inquiry.

stories.title: Türkiye and Saudi Arabia Sign Defence Development Cooperation Agreement
stories.summary:
Türkiye and Saudi Arabia have signed a memorandum of understanding to bolster cooperation in the defence industry, as announced by Turkish defence industries chief Haluk Gorgun on Thursday. The agreement was concluded between Türkiye’s Presidency of Defence Industries and Saudi Arabia’s General Authority for Defence Development, with GADD President Faleh bin Abdullah Al-Sulaiman taking part in the signing.

The pact focuses on collaborative efforts in research, development, and innovation concerning defense and military technologies and systems. Both sides hope the partnership will yield mutual benefits for the two nations, and Gorgun thanked Al-Sulaiman and his delegation for their visit during the proceedings.

In addition to the signing, Gorgun addressed security matters by offering Türkiye's condolences and support following an attack directed at the King Abdullah Financial District in Riyadh. He condemned the hostile act and reaffirmed solidarity with the Saudi population.

The new agreement highlights deepening ties between Ankara and Riyadh in the military technology sector. It also underscores ongoing diplomatic engagements amidst regional security concerns in the Middle East.

stories.title: Government Proposes Capping Power Tariff Increases Due to Fuel Surges
stories.summary:
The Power Division announced a proposal to limit monthly fuel cost adjustments to approximately Re0.83 per unit, inclusive of taxes, for the period covering October to December 2026. This administrative measure aims to protect electricity consumers from escalating fuel prices resulting from the ongoing conflict between Iran and the United States.

According to the Power Division, international prices for coal and RLNG escalated sharply due to the geopolitical tensions, creating intense upward pressure on monthly fuel cost adjustments. During the previous period from April to September 2026, the division implemented load management strategies and optimized available fuel supplies, successfully shielding consumers from an additional potential increase of Rs6 to Rs7 per unit.

Winter conditions typically compound these financial challenges because lower hydropower generation causes reliance on thermal generation to spike, with thermal fuels sometimes representing over 80 percent of the mix. Elevated international fuel costs would normally drive a substantial rise in monthly adjustments during these colder months, but the newly proposed Forward-Looking Fuel Cost Adjustment mechanism sets a strict limit on the hike over September levels.

Once official approvals are secured, the Power Division will issue formal policy guidelines to NEPRA to execute the mechanism. This initiative underscores the government's objective to maintain tariff stability and cushion local electricity users from external fuel shocks and market volatility.

stories.title: Iran Revolutionary Guards Claim Sea Mines Hit Tankers Near Oman
stories.summary:
Iran’s Revolutionary Guards stated that two oil tankers experienced explosions and caught fire after striking sea mines north of Oman’s Khasab port while attempting to navigate the Strait of Hormuz via an unauthorized route. Among the affected vessels was a supertanker transporting more than 2 million barrels of crude oil.

Tehran maintains that maritime vessels cannot safely transit the Strait of Hormuz without coordinating directly with Iranian authorities, citing dangers such as sea mines. However, international maritime security agencies frequently log similar incidents as strikes by unidentified projectiles, often recording fewer events than reported by the Revolutionary Guards and differing on details.

Simultaneously, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency documented an explosion caused by an unknown projectile near a tanker situated roughly 50 nautical miles west of Dubai. Revolutionary Guards spokesman Hossein Mohebbi explained that the military force is utilizing heavy firepower to restrict access to the strait, aiming to increase pressure on the United States economy while defending Iran.

Since October, Iran has introduced aggressive tactics targeting shipping lanes in the Strait of Hormuz to counter recovering Gulf oil flows backed by US Navy assistance and daring tanker operators. Revolutionary Guards Navy commander Rear Admiral Ali Azmaei emphasized that Iran retains complete operational control over the strait and that safe passage relies entirely on acknowledging Iran's sovereign rights.

stories.title: PIA Resumes UK Flights Utilizing Its Own Boeing 777 Fleet
stories.summary:
Pakistan International Airlines successfully restored its flight operations between Pakistan and the United Kingdom after cancelling two scheduled services earlier in the week due to the sudden suspension of operations by its wet-lease partner, Norse Atlantic Airways. The national carrier shifted its UK routes directly to its own Boeing 777 aircraft.

The disruption began when Norse Atlantic halted its services without giving prior notice, forcing the cancellation of flight PK-786 from London to Islamabad and flight PK-710 from Manchester to Lahore just before check-in was scheduled to begin. In response, PIA deployed a contingency strategy to handle the affected travelers at the airports in London and Manchester.

Impacted passengers were re-booked on subsequent flights according to their travel preferences. Furthermore, individuals who chose to alter or postpone their journeys were granted complete ticket refunds without incurring any financial penalties.

The airline confirmed that all scheduled UK flights resumed smoothly, while operations across the remainder of its domestic and international network continued without interruption. By transitioning entirely to its own Boeing 777 fleet for these routes, PIA eliminated its reliance on third-party operators to ensure long-term service reliability.

stories.title: Karachi Building Collapse Prompts Dismissals and Crackdown on Illegal Construction
stories.summary:
Sindh Local Government Secretary and SBCA chief Waseem Shamshad has been removed from his responsibilities following the deadly collapse of an under-construction building in Karachi's Baloch Colony. Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah orchestrated a sweeping government response during an emergency meeting, which also resulted in the removal of East Deputy Commissioner Nasrullah Abbasi and SSP East Zubair Sheikh due to severe administrative negligence.

The incident unfolded when a ground-plus-five-storey structure with an additional penthouse collapsed while workers were conducting borehole excavation. The disaster left at least three people dead and 14 injured, while rescue authorities noted that families of 17 missing individuals had registered at a newly established information desk. Initial investigations reveal that the owner originally secured approval for a ground-plus-one-storey layout but unlawfully expanded the structure to six storeys.

In response to the tragedy, the provincial government transferred Shamshad, appointed Bilal Memon as the new Local Government Secretary, and initiated suspensions for 16 additional SBCA personnel. Chief Minister Shah instructed law enforcement to immediately arrest the building owner Salman Tahir and builder Zeeshan, while also probing the roles of the architect and structural engineer. He stressed that public safety remains paramount and warned that regulatory failures will invite strict punitive measures.

During a subsequent press briefing, CM Shah highlighted that authorities have successfully frozen construction on 123 buildings operating under court stay orders, including the collapsed site. He urged the judiciary to expedite verdicts on these disputed structures within 15 days, while announcing a comprehensive organizational reset for the SBCA to eliminate systemic corruption and weed out negligent employees.

stories.title: Pakistani Rupee Edges Higher Against US Dollar in Inter-Bank Trading
stories.summary:
The Pakistani rupee posted a modest gain against the US dollar in the inter-bank market during Thursday's trading session. The local currency closed the day valued at 276.45 against the greenback, reflecting a marginal improvement of Re0.01 compared to the previous session's close of 276.46.

Globally, the US dollar remained relatively stable during Asian market hours after dipping to a one-week low overnight. Falling Treasury yields and subdued risk sentiment contributed to the greenback's movement ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday, offsetting its traditional safe-haven status. The broader US dollar index hovered near 103.7, remaining well below the 19-month peak reached earlier in the week.

International currency markets also observed minor fluctuations in other major pairs. The Japanese yen appreciated slightly by 0.1% to trade around 159.06, while the euro held steady near $1.097 as investors awaited the release of the European Central Bank's October meeting minutes. Concurrently, international oil prices experienced an upward trend driven by fresh supply concerns in the Middle East, with Brent crude futures rising to $94.71 a barrel and WTI crude climbing to $83.99 a barrel.

Domestically, the minor appreciation of the rupee occurs alongside various economic developments in Pakistan, including upcoming international alliance meetings, security updates from Balochistan, and ongoing adjustments in fuel and gold prices. The foreign exchange movement highlights steady near-term performance for the local unit amidst shifting global financial indicators.

stories.title: WNBA Stars Gather in Mexico for Lexie Hull and Will Matthiessen Wedding
stories.summary:
Indiana Fever guard Lexie Hull married her longtime partner and former minor league baseball player Will Matthiessen in a destination ceremony held in Cabo San Lucas, Mexico, on November 21, 2026. The couple, who first met during their college years at Stanford University, exchanged handwritten vows in front of 120 guests at the cliffside beach property Sunset Monalisa.

The wedding festivities included a bridal shower and a bachelor brunch, though the couple kept the details private until sharing official photographs on social media. Prominent WNBA figures, including teammates Caitlin Clark and Sophie Cunningham, traveled to Mexico to join the celebration and shared enthusiastic congratulatory messages online.

The ceremony featured a polished coastal design curated around neutral colors, organic textures, and subtle ocean tones. Hull walked down the aisle in a strapless dress designed by KYHA as renditions of romantic music played, while the event itself was officiated by Clay Jones.

Following the wedding weekend, the newlyweds extended their stay in Cabo San Lucas alongside friends and family to enjoy boat outings, beach visits, and dining. The couple plans to take a trip to Europe in March 2027 ahead of the upcoming WNBA season.

stories.title: Gold Prices Surge Across Pakistan Following International Market Gains
stories.summary:
Gold prices in Pakistan experienced a significant upward movement on Thursday, driven by positive momentum in the global market. According to figures provided by the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association (APGJSA), the local price of gold per tola increased by Rs4,700, reaching a total of Rs378,636. This increase follows a notable drop recorded on the previous day.

Alongside the per tola rate, the price for 10 grams of gold also saw an upward adjustment, selling at Rs324,619 after a gain of Rs4,030. These domestic market shifts directly mirrored trends on the international stage, where the global rate of gold climbed by $47 to reach $3,561 per ounce. In addition to precious yellow metal gains, the local price of silver recorded an increase of Rs166, bringing its per tola rate to Rs4,629.

The domestic adjustments follow a volatile preceding session. On Wednesday, gold prices had dropped sharply, with the per tola rate decreasing by Rs11,500 to settle at Rs373,936. Market participants and analysts closely track these frequent fluctuations as local jewelers adjust rates in real time based on international spot valuations and domestic currency exchange dynamics.

The simultaneous rise in both gold and silver prices impacts retail buyers and investors across the country as they navigate fluctuating commodity markets. The APGJSA continues to issue official daily rate sheets to keep traders and consumers informed about prevailing market conditions in major Pakistani cities.

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Launches Mehfooz Dawa App to Fight Fake Drugs
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif officially launched the “Mehfooz Dawa” digital application in Islamabad on Thursday. Designed to tackle the circulation of counterfeit and substandard medications, the initiative is aimed at restoring public trust in the country's healthcare system. Speaking at the inaugural ceremony, the prime minister emphasized that health and education facilities must be equally accessible to every citizen, while stressing that federal and provincial governments must collaborate to ensure affordable, quality medicines.

The launch event featured addresses by Federal Minister for National Health Services Mustafa Kamal and Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP) Chief Executive Officer Dr Obaidullah. Prime Minister Shehbaz hailed the app as a magnificent milestone, while recalling a tragic 2012 incident at the Punjab Institute of Cardiology where over 100 patient deaths were blamed on counterfeit medication. He urged authorities to learn from past failures and praised the collaborative effort required to compile a database covering approximately 92,000 medicines from over 700 pharmaceutical companies.

Detailing the app's functions, Dr Obaidullah explained that the application addresses counterfeit products, shortages, and quality compliance through three core features: medicine verification, complaint lodging, and shortage reporting. Users can verify authenticity by scanning a medicine's batch number, which triggers a check against the DRAP database. The application displays a green screen for genuine products and a red screen for counterfeits, allowing consumers to immediately report fake items.

The track-and-trace system supporting the initiative became operational on October 9, following years of bureaucratic delays after its initial proposal in 2015 and cabinet approval in 2017. Health ministry officials remain dedicated to ensuring that citizens have access to safe therapeutic products, while the prime minister has directed relevant ministries to raise public awareness about the app's usage.

stories.title: Security Forces Eliminate 12 Terrorists in Balochistan Intelligence Operations
stories.summary:
Pakistan security forces neutralized 12 terrorists linked to the India-backed Fitna al-Hindustan group during multiple intelligence-based operations conducted in Balochistan between November 20 and November 23. According to the Inter-Services Public Relations, the military's media wing, the operations spanned across the districts of Nushki, Sevi, Panjgur, and Kech.

The initial engagement took place on November 20 in the Nushki district, where security forces targeted a militant hideout and killed eight terrorists after an intense firefight, while also recovering weapons and ammunition. On November 21, authorities intercepted militant movement in the Sevi district, resulting in the deaths of two additional fighters. Two further engagements on November 22 and 23 in the Panjgur and Kech districts successfully eliminated two more members of the same group.

The military has vowed that its relentless counterterrorism campaign will continue at full pace to eradicate foreign-sponsored and supported terrorism from the country. This comes amid a broader surge in violence across Pakistan, particularly in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan provinces, following the Afghan Taliban's rise to power in 2021.

A report by the Centre for Research and Security Studies highlighted that Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan accounted for nearly 96 percent of all violence-related fatalities during the second quarter of 2026. Khyber Pakhtunkhwa recorded the highest number of casualties and violent incidents, while Balochistan represented the second-largest share of regional unrest, underscoring the severe concentration of militant activity in these two provinces.

stories.title: UK Net Migration Drops to Lowest Level Since 1997
stories.summary:
Britain recorded an annual net migration decline to 77,000 in the year leading up to the end of June, marking the lowest figure outside of the COVID-19 pandemic since 1997. Official statistics released on Thursday revealed a sharp drop from 204,000 the previous year, reflecting a roughly 90% plunge from the peak of nearly a million people in 2023.

The significant decrease stems from tighter restrictions implemented by former and current administrations on work visas, student arrivals, and asylum seekers, alongside higher salary thresholds and dependent bans. Interior minister Shabana Mahmood stated that the government has regained control of the immigration system, though populist figures and parties argued the long-term influx has severely strained public services and housing.

While the ONS noted that a reduction in long-term migration from individuals born outside the European Union drove the decline, economists warned of potential economic consequences. Experts from Oxford Economics and other institutions suggested that sustained low immigration could shrink the British workforce, slow growth potential, and tighten public finances.

The milestone fulfills a long-sought political goal initially pledged by former Prime Minister David Cameron in 2010. However, think tanks like British Future noted that the dramatic drop may surprise voters accustomed to debates about surging arrivals, prompting calls for politicians to establish sustainable long-term immigration levels.

stories.title: Major Trading Partners Reject Proposed US Tariffs on Overcapacity
stories.summary:
Major global economies, including China and the European Union, have strongly criticized proposed United States tariffs following a lengthy investigation into alleged excess production. The new tolls, reaching up to 20 percent, target trading partners such as India, Japan, South Korea, Indonesia, and Vietnam, and will undergo a public comment period before potentially taking effect in January.

US trade officials defended the measures as a necessary response to mass production at a loss that undercuts local rivals and threatens the domestic manufacturing base. However, Beijing dismissed the overcapacity rationale as a pretext for protectionism and threatened to take measures to defend its rights. Other nations, including Japan and Singapore, similarly denied engaging in non-market practices or subsidizing domestic manufacturing.

The levies form part of President Donald Trump's broader second-term strategy to reshape global trade by compelling countries to buy American goods or shift production to the US. Trade lawyers noted that the probe addresses fears of foreign factories flooding global markets with excess goods, potentially depressing prices and hollowing out American industry.

The announcement coincides with data showing high domestic inflation and follows recent legislative shifts in Washington. While the Supreme Court struck down broader global tariffs earlier in the year, sector-specific and forced-labour duties remain in place, with the administration stating that the new production levies will not stack on top of existing ones.

stories.title: Sophie Cunningham Reacts to Drew Hanlen Wedding News
stories.summary:
Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham shared her reaction to a major life update from her No Hesitation podcast co-host, NBA skills trainer Drew Hanlen, who posted wedding photos with his wife Christine on Instagram. Cunningham left a single-word comment reading “beautiful” on the post, highlighting their close friendship formed through the podcast. 

Although Cunningham's attendance at the ceremony was not confirmed, the WNBA guard has kept busy during the offseason with recent appearances in Chicago and Las Vegas. In the meantime, the co-hosts announced that No Hesitation will pause for Thanksgiving week, leaving fans without a new episode. 

The podcast launched six months prior in September 2026, blending WNBA and NBA analysis, film breakdowns, and off-court content to provide weekly updates during the offseason. Cunningham is coming off a solid season for Indiana, averaging 7.9 points, 2.3 rebounds, and 1.2 assists while shooting 41.9% from beyond the arc to help the Fever reach the playoffs. 

With basketball temporarily sidelined for holiday festivities, both co-hosts are using the week to hit the reset button. The wedding news follows another recent nuptial in the franchise, as Fever guard Lexie Hull married former minor league baseball player Will Matthiessen in Cabo San Lucas, Mexico on November 21, 2026, in front of 120 guests.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz Sharif Praises Historic Shenzhou-24 Space Mission
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif met with Chinese Ambassador Jiang Zaidong at the Prime Minister House in Islamabad on Thursday, November 26, to discuss bilateral relations and celebrate a historic milestone in space exploration. The meeting came after Wing Commander Muhammad Zeeshan Ali boarded China's Tiangong space station on Wednesday, becoming the first foreign astronaut and the first Pakistani to travel into orbit. 

Serving as a payload specialist on the three-member Shenzhou-24 mission, Ali is expected to remain stationed in space for five to ten days. Prime Minister Shehbaz congratulated the Chinese envoy, leadership, and people on the successful launch, expressing gratitude to Beijing for providing the opportunity to participate in the mission and train Pakistani astronauts. 

Describing the achievement as a journey representing 240 million Pakistanis and the dreams of the nation's youth and scientific community, the prime minister called the mission living proof of the ironclad friendship between Pakistan and China. He also paid tribute to Pakistan's Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (Suparco), academic institutions, scientists, and the armed forces for their contributions. 

During the discussions, both sides reviewed bilateral ties, including celebrations for the 75th anniversary of diplomatic relations. Prime Minister Shehbaz handed over congratulatory letters addressed to President Xi Jinping and Premier Li Qiang to the ambassador, while reaffirming Pakistan's commitment to cooperating with China for the peaceful utilization of outer space.

stories.title: JI Karachi Chief Accuses Sindh Government of Patronising Illegal Construction
stories.summary:
Jamaat-e-Islami (JI) Karachi chief Munem Zafar Khan alleged on Thursday that billions of rupees in black money are tied to illegal construction across the city. Speaking during a site visit to a collapsed building in the Karachi Administration Employees Cooperative Housing Society (KAECHS), he accused the Sindh Building Control Authority (SBCA) and the provincial government of protecting unlawful building activities and fostering a corrupt system.

Accompanied by Karachi Metropolitan Corporation (KMC) Opposition Leader Saifuddin Advocate, Munem Zafar claimed that many newly constructed buildings in Karachi are unsafe and erected within a few months without qualified engineers or architects. He criticized authorities for failing to investigate the massive financial transactions involved in these properties and stated that Karachi has been left at the mercy of builder and SBCA mafias. Furthermore, he noted that a local union committee chairman had submitted multiple requests for action against unauthorized construction this year without any response.

Saifuddin Advocate echoed these concerns, questioning whether Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah was unaware of the unauthorized structures that have multiplied over the past five years. He highlighted that these illegal buildings easily secure essential utility connections like water, electricity, and gas, pointing to the involvement of various government departments beyond just the builders.

The remarks follow a recent building collapse in the city, which Sindh Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah described as murder rather than an accident as authorities face mounting pressure over lax oversight and corruption in the urban housing sector.

stories.title: Sindh Government Orders Immediate Halt and Demolition of Illegal Buildings
stories.summary:
The Sindh government has directed the Sindh Building Control Authority to immediately halt construction on all unauthorized buildings across the province and initiate demolition proceedings against gross violations, particularly unoccupied structures. Issued by the Local Government and Housing Town Planning Department on November 26, the directive mandates that construction must stop instantly even where stay or restraining orders exist, with such legal cases to be prioritized alongside district attorneys.

Under the notification, grossly illegal or completed structures lacking proper approvals will be targeted for demolition using standard operating procedures with assistance from district administrations. SBCA Director General Bilal Ahmed Memon was tasked with overseeing the enforcement of these orders, which were formally signed by Sindh Secretary Bilal Ahmed Memon.

The provincial directive follows a series of deadly structural incidents in Karachi, including the collapse of a six-storey under-construction building in the Baloch Colony area that killed four people and injured 14 others. Initial investigations into that collapse revealed that six extra floors had allegedly been constructed without approval beyond the permitted basement, ground floor, and single storey.

Additional incidents earlier in the year—such as bridge and residential building collapses due to structural flaws and gas leaks—have intensified public scrutiny over regulatory oversight and construction safety in the region. The latest government order aims to address unchecked illegal expansion and prevent further tragedies across local neighborhoods.

stories.title: Swat Motorbike Passenger Becomes Global Cricket Sensation After One-Handed Catch
stories.summary:
Mehran Khan, a 27-year-old civil servant and amateur cricketer from Pakistan, achieved worldwide fame after completing an extraordinary one-handed catch from the back of a moving motorbike. The incident occurred on Tuesday in Mingora, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, as Khan and a friend were riding past a Swat Premier League match. Batsman Abrar Lala hit a looping six that sailed over the boundary toward the adjacent road, prompting Khan to stand up slightly on the vehicle and pluck the ball out of the air.

An employee of the Public Health Engineering Department who has played cricket since childhood, Khan described the act as pure instinct. Following the event, a local TikTok user uploaded footage of the catch, which quickly went viral globally and caught the attention of cricket legends. Australian fast bowler Brett Lee shared the video on Facebook, calling it an unbelievable catch, which left Khan thrilled and overwhelmed by the unexpected recognition.

Police and event commentators stopped Khan and his friend as they sped past, calling them back into the ground where spectators and players greeted them with loud applause. Tournament organisers rewarded Khan with Rs10,000 for his feat. Although social media users joked that he stole the match ball, Khan clarified that he handed it directly to the tournament organisers and expressed hope that they would eventually return it to him as a keepsake.

Khan attributes his recent good fortune to the birth of his daughter eight months ago, believing her arrival kicked off a lucky streak that led to the iconic moment. He noted that his life has completely changed since the video spread, with strangers frequently stopping him for selfies. Grateful for the respect and recognition, the mountain resident remarked that a single catch transformed him from an ordinary player into someone very special.

stories.title: خیبر کے علاقے باڑہ میں سیکیورٹی فورسز کے آپریشن کے دوران چار خوارج ہلاک
stories.summary:
خیبر کے علاقے باڑہ میں سیکیورٹی فورسز نے انٹیلی جنس کی بنیاد پر ایک اہم کارروائی کرتے ہوئے انتہائی مطلوب خارجی خمیم عرف رؤف سمیت چار دہشت گردوں کو ہلاک کر دیا ہے۔

سیکیورٹی ذرائع کے مطابق ہلاک ہونے والا یہ دہشت گرد سیکیورٹی فورسز اور عام شہریوں کے خلاف متعدد دہشت گردانہ کارروائیوں میں ملوث رہا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ خارجی رؤف نے کچھ عرصہ قبل باچا خان ایئر پورٹ کو نشانہ بنانے کی دھمکی آمیز ویڈیو بھی سوشل میڈیا پر اپ لوڈ کی تھی۔

پاک فوج کے شعبہ تعلقات عامہ (آئی ایس پی آر) نے بتایا ہے کہ آپریشن کے دوران ہلاک ہونے والے دہشت گردوں کے قبضے سے بڑی تعداد میں اسلحہ اور گولہ بارود بھی برآمد کر لیا گیا ہے۔

سیکیورٹی اداروں کا کہنا ہے کہ ملک سے اس فتنے کے تمام باقی ماندہ عناصر کا مکمل صفایا کرنے کے لیے کارروائیاں تاحال جاری رکھی جا رہی ہیں تاکہ امن و امان کا قیام یقینی بنایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: تحریکِ انصاف کے رہنما شوکت یوسفزئی کی جانب سے قومی حکومت کی تجویز مسترد
stories.summary:
پاکستان تحریکِ انصاف خیبر پختونخوا کے سیکریٹری اطلاعات شوکت یوسفزئی نے ایک بیان میں واضح کیا ہے کہ ان کی جماعت ملک میں کسی بھی قومی حکومت کی تجویز کو یکسر مسترد کرتی ہے۔ انہوں نے دو ٹوک الفاظ میں کہا ہے کہ موجودہ حکومت کے ساتھ کسی قسم کی کوئی ڈیل نہیں کی جائے گی۔

شوکت یوسفزئی کا کہنا تھا کہ ملک میں اس وقت مفاہمت اور قومی سطح پر مکالمے کی ضرورت پہلے سے کہیں زیادہ محسوس کی جا رہی ہے۔ تاہم انہوں نے یہ بھی واضح کیا کہ نئے صوبوں کے قیام اور اٹھائیسویں آئینی ترمیم کے حوالے سے کسی بھی قسم کی گفتگو یا حتمی فیصلہ حکومتی مسودہ سامنے آنے کے بعد ہی کیا جائے گا، کیونکہ تحریکِ انصاف نئے صوبوں کی قیام کی مخالفت نہیں کرتی۔

پی ٹی آئی رہنما کا مزید کہنا تھا کہ ملک میں دیرپا امن کے نفاذ کے لیے نیشنل ایکشن پلان پر سختی سے عمل درآمد کرانا انتہائی ضروری ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ انہوں نے یہ بھی مطالبہ کیا کہ 26 نومبر کو پیش آنے والے واقعے کی مکمل عدالتی تحقیقات کروائی جانی چاہئیں۔

stories.title: راولپنڈی کے علاقے کہوٹہ میں پسند کی شادی کرنے والی لڑکی قتل
stories.summary:
راولپنڈی کے علاقہ کہوٹہ میں پسند کی شادی کرنے کے تنازع پر ایک انیس سالہ لڑکی کو سفاکیت کا نشانہ بناتے ہوئے قتل کر دیا گیا۔ واقعے کے بعد مقامی پولیس نے فوری کارروائی کرتے ہوئے مقتولہ کے والد اور بھائی کو حراست میں لے لیا ہے۔

پولیس ذرائع کے مطابق مقتولہ کے گھر والے اس کی جانب سے اپنی مرضی سے شادی کیے جانے پر شدید ناخوش تھے۔ شوہر کے بیان کے مطابق اس کی بیوی کو اس کے اپنے بھائی نے تیز دھار آلے کے پے در پے وار کر کے شدید زخمی کیا تھا، جو اسپتال میں دورانِ علاج زخموں کی تاب نہ لاتے ہوئے دم توڑ گئی۔

مقتولہ کے شوہر نے الزام عائد کیا ہے کہ لڑکی کے ورثاء نے اسے واقعے کی کوئی اطلاع دیے بغیر ہی اس کی لاش کی تدفین کر دی تھی۔ پولیس کی جانب سے اس واقعے کی مزید تفتیش کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے تاکہ تمام حقائق سامنے لائے جا سکیں۔

stories.title: Pakistan Misses Azlan Shah Cup Final After Dramatic Draw Against Malaysia
stories.summary:
Pakistan missed out on a place in the final of the Sultan Azlan Shah Cup after conceding a late goal to draw 5-5 against hosts Malaysia in a thrilling final group-stage match in Ipoh on Thursday. The result left both national teams level with ten points each, but Malaysia advanced to the title clash due to a superior goal average. Pakistan will now face South Korea in the third-place playoff on Saturday, while Malaysia prepares to play Australia.

Pakistan appeared headed for victory when Sufyan Khan successfully converted a penalty corner with just three minutes remaining, giving the Green Shirts a 5-4 lead. However, Malaysia secured a dramatic draw when Faizal Saari completed his hat-trick by converting a late penalty in the closing stages. The match underlined recurring defensive vulnerabilities for Pakistan, who repeatedly struggled to protect their leads throughout the tournament despite showing strong attacking potential.

The game saw frequent momentum shifts from the start. Malaysia opened the scoring through Abu Kamal Azari in the third minute, but Pakistan answered quickly with two goals from Ahmed Nadeem in the 12th and 15th minutes. After Jalil Marhan equalised via a penalty corner in the 20th minute, Pakistan briefly played with ten men following a green card issued to Rana Waheed Ashraf. Pakistan then surged ahead in the second half with goals from Muhammad Ahmed in the 35th minute and Hannan Shahid in the 47th minute.

Malaysia mounted a swift response when Saari struck twice in the 49th minute via penalty corners to tie the score at 4-4. Although Sufyan's late penalty corner briefly restored Pakistan's lead, Saari's third conversion denied them the win. Missing the leadership of experienced defender Ammad Butt, Pakistan must now regroup to face South Korea, while Malaysia carries their momentum forward to face Australia on home soil.

stories.title: Two-Time Champion Jannik Sinner Ruled Out of Australian Open After Knee Surgery
stories.summary:
World number two Jannik Sinner will miss the Australian Open in January as he continues his recovery from right knee surgery. The Italian tennis star, who won the season-opening Grand Slam in both 2024 and 2025, underwent a procedure at a clinic in Finland after non-surgical treatments failed to resolve his lingering iliotibial band issue.

Tennis Australia chief Andrew Abdo confirmed the absence after staying in regular contact with Sinner's team, noting that the player looks forward to returning for the 2028 tournament. Medical experts speculate that Sinner's recovery could take up to three months, potentially sidelining him until the American hard-court swing at Indian Wells and the Miami Masters in February and March. Sinner has not played a competitive match since capturing his second Wimbledon title in July.

Before his injury troubles, the 25-year-old enjoyed a stellar campaign, boasting a career-best 94 percent win record alongside five Masters 1000 titles. His absence at the top of the rankings has allowed Alexander Zverev to take over as world number one. Fellow players, including world number three Carlos Alcaraz, expressed their support and disappointment over the Italian's absence from the tour.

Sinner claimed his maiden Grand Slam at Melbourne Park in 2024 by defeating Daniil Medvedev, and successfully defended the title against Alexander Zverev the following year. He reached the semi-finals earlier this year before losing to Novak Djokovic. The upcoming Australian Open is scheduled to begin on January 17.

stories.title: سرگودھا انتظامیہ کی مولانا فضل الرحمان کے داخلے پر پابندی، جے یو آئی کا جلسہ کرنے کا اعلان
stories.summary:
پنجاب کے ضلع سرگودھا کی انتظامیہ نے جمعیت علمائے اسلام (ف) کے سربراہ مولانا فضل الرحمان سمیت نو افراد کے ضلع کی حدود میں داخل ہونے پر پابندی عائد کر دی ہے۔ یہ فیصلہ ضلعی پولیس کی رپورٹ اور امن و عامہ کے خدشات کے پیش نظر کیا گیا ہے، جبکہ سرگودھا میں پہلے ہی دفعہ 144 نافذ ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ ضلع کے 19 مقامی علما اور مذہبی رہنماؤں کی تقاریر پر بھی 30 روز کے لیے پابندی عائد کی گئی ہے۔

حکم نامے کے مطابق جن نو افراد کے داخلے پر پابندی لگائی گئی ہے ان میں مولانا فضل الرحمان، مولانا نصیر احمد ابرار، مولانا امجد خان، مولانا صفیع اللہ، پروفیسر غضنفر عزیز، مولانا محمد نور خان، مولانا محمد زکریا شاہ، مولانا محمد یحیی اور مولانا محمد جمیل عبد الناصر شامل ہیں۔ انتظامیہ کا مؤقف ہے کہ ان افراد کا ماضی میں اشتعال انگیز تقاریر کا ریکارڈ رہا ہے جو امن عامہ کے لیے نقصان دہ ہو سکتی ہیں۔

ان حکومتی اقدامات کے باوجود جمعیت علمائے اسلام نے اعلان کیا ہے کہ وہ سرگودھا میں ہر صورت جلسہ کرے گی۔ جے یو آئی پنجاب کے ترجمان حافظ غضنفر عزیز کے مطابق اس تقریب کو تحفظ آئین پاکستان و عوامی حقوق کانفرنس کا نام دیا گیا ہے، جس کی تیاریاں مکمل ہیں اور مرکزی قافلے کی قیادت مولانا فضل الرحمن اور حافظ نصیر احمد احرار کریں گے۔

ترجمان جے یو آئی نے حکمرانوں پر زور دیا ہے کہ وہ آئینی اور قانونی جدوجہد کے راستے میں رکاوٹیں نہ ڈالیں۔ انہوں نے کارکنوں کو ہدایت کی ہے کہ وہ پرامن رہیں، کسی قسم کے اشتعال میں نہ آئیں اور آئین کی بالادستی، قانون کی عملداری اور جمہوری اقدار کی پاسداری کے لیے اپنا حق استعمال کریں۔

stories.title: Motorbike Passenger in Swat Becomes Viral Cricket Sensation After Catch
stories.summary:
Mehran Khan, a 27-year-old civil servant and amateur cricketer from Pakistan, gained international recognition after executing a remarkable one-handed catch while riding on the back of a moving motorcycle. The event took place on Tuesday in Mingora, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, as Khan and a friend were commuting home from work past a Swat Premier League match. When batsman Abrar Lala struck a looping six toward the road, Khan stood up slightly on the bike and caught the ball out of the air with one hand.

A government employee with the Public Health Engineering Department who has played cricket since childhood, Khan stated that the catch was driven entirely by instinct. A local TikTok user recorded and uploaded the moment, which rapidly spread across social media platforms. Khan expressed immense pride upon discovering that Australian fast bowler Brett Lee shared the footage on his Facebook page, describing it as an unbelievable honor for an ordinary player.

Tournament commentators spotted the speeding motorbike and instructed police to bring the pair back to the venue. Upon entering the ground, Khan was greeted by roaring applause from players and spectators, and tournament organizers presented him with a cash reward of Rs10,000. Addressing online jokes that he stole the cricket ball, Khan clarified that he promptly surrendered it to the organizers inside the ground, though he hopes to retrieve it eventually as a personal souvenir.

Khan believes his recent stroke of good fortune stems from the birth of his daughter eight months ago, noting that everything has gone well for him since she arrived. The sudden fame has dramatically altered his daily routine, with locals frequently asking him for selfies both in public and when he returned home to a celebratory welcome from his family. He reflected that the single moment turned an ordinary mountain resident into someone very special.

stories.title: Yemen's Houthi Movement Claims Responsibility for Attack on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura Refinery
stories.summary:
Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthi movement stated that they launched an attack on Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery, Ras Tanura, situated alongside a major crude export terminal in the kingdom's Eastern Province. Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree reported that the strike triggered fires at the facility, while satellite imagery from NASA and Planet Labs revealed thick black smoke covering approximately 600 square kilometres.

The Saudi-led coalition stated that air defences intercepted and destroyed four drones over Ras Tanura, without confirming any direct hit on the refinery itself. However, a source familiar with the situation verified the strike, while the Saudi government and state oil firm Aramco did not immediately provide comments. Ras Tanura has a refining capacity of 550,000 barrels per day and has previously been targeted during conflicts with the Houthis and broader regional hostilities.

In addition to the refinery incident, Houthi attacks have intensified since the group captured strategic areas along Yemen's Red Sea coast in September, moving toward the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. Saree also claimed attacks on the ports of Jeddah and Jazan, with a projectile causing minor damage but no injuries at Jazan port. Furthermore, Saudi civil defence reported that 11 people were wounded in a separate strike on the tallest building in Riyadh's financial district, which houses the Public Investment Fund.

The renewed escalation follows a spillover from the US-Iran war that reignited Yemen's frozen civil war in July. Previous Houthi operations have temporarily disrupted Aramco operations, caused flight cancellations to Riyadh, and forced the postponement of major international events in Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Makkah Pact Nations to Address Regional Conflict and Yemen at Islamabad Summit
stories.summary:
Defence ministers and foreign officials from Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Türkiye are set to convene in Islamabad to discuss regional security, with the ongoing conflict in Yemen and Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia serving as a primary agenda item. Pakistani Defence Minister Khawaja Asif confirmed the upcoming talks to AFP, emphasizing that continuous turmoil south of Saudi Arabia is a critical issue for the mutual defence agreement.

The three Muslim nations signed the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement in August, establishing a pact where each country pledges military assistance if another is attacked. Asif noted that under the agreement, any threat directed at Saudi Arabia is considered a threat to both Pakistan and Türkiye. He also mentioned that the pact remains at a nascent stage, requiring frequent meetings over the next couple of months to fully operationalize its framework.

While declining to speculate on how the alliance would respond to direct aggression from Iran, Asif pointed to Israel as another potential regional threat that necessitates closer cooperation among area nations. He also addressed broader diplomatic efforts, highlighting Pakistan's constructive role in mediating a brief truce earlier in the year between the United States and Iran regarding the Strait of Hormuz and nuclear negotiations.

However, Asif cautioned that ongoing diplomatic mediation remains fragile and peace is not yet firmly established. The Islamabad meeting comes amid heightened tensions in the Middle East, marked by recent Houthi strikes on Saudi oil facilities and infrastructure as well as high-level diplomatic contacts, including a recent meeting between Pakistan's Army Chief Field Marshal Asim Munir and Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi.

stories.title: Rana Irfan Captures IBSF World Cup Snooker Title in Muscat
stories.summary:
Pakistan's Rana Irfan, originating from Multan, secured the men's singles gold medal at the IBSF World Cup in Muscat, Oman, after defeating his compatriot Muhammad Asif in a one-sided, all-Pakistan final with a score of 5-0. Irfan demonstrated absolute control throughout the championship match, opening with a 96-46 victory featuring a break of 56, followed by wins of 67-48, 64-1, 91-12 with a 68 break, and closing the contest with a 69-6 scoreline in the fifth frame.

The tournament witnessed a strong overall medal performance by Pakistani cueists, with Muhammad Asif claiming the silver medal and Asjad Iqbal earning bronze following a semi-final appearance. To reach the title clash, Asif had earlier defeated Afghanistan's Mohammad Rais Senzah 4-1, while Irfan narrowly overcame Asjad Iqbal 4-3 in a dramatic seven-frame semi-final that featured a maximum 123 break by Iqbal before Irfan clinched the decider 69-15.

During the quarter-finals, Asif eliminated England's Harvay Chandler 4-1, Iqbal overcame Iran's Amir Sarkosh 4-2 with the help of a 105-point clearance, and Irfan mounted a remarkable comeback from two frames down to defeat fellow Pakistani Mubashir Raza 4-2.

The individual tournament's conclusion paves the way for the team event, which is scheduled to commence on Friday in Muscat. Pakistan aims to maintain the winning momentum generated by its players during the individual rounds as the World Cup continues.

stories.title: Karachi Court Acquits 32 Suspects in Gulshan Iqbal Illegal Call Centre Case
stories.summary:
A local judicial magistrate court in East Karachi has officially acquitted 32 individuals who were facing charges in a National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) case regarding an illegal call centre operating in the Gulshan Iqbal area. The court granted the acquittal petitions for all 32 accused individuals after reviewing the case over a period of five months.

In its formal ruling, the court stated that the prosecution completely failed to produce any evidence capable of connecting the defendants individually to the alleged crime. The judicial decision noted that the head of the raiding team confessed an inability to specify which recovered equipment belonged to or was found with any particular accused person. Furthermore, a prosecution witness admitted during proceedings that they never witnessed any of the devices actually in the hands of the suspects.

The court also highlighted severe flaws in the handling of digital evidence, pointing out that the prosecution could not maintain a proper chain of custody for the items seized during the operation. Authorities initially recovered more than 45 pieces of equipment, but preliminary analysis was restricted to only three laptops and a single phone. Moreover, officials failed to submit any relevant forensic report regarding the laptops.

Concluding that a conviction was legally impossible given the total lack of substantiated proof and broken evidentiary chains, the magistrate dismissed all charges against the accused. The case underscores major procedural and investigative shortcomings in handling cyber-crime operations involving digital technology infrastructure.

stories.title: انڈین حکومت کا نیٹ فلکس سے پاکستانی سیریز ’جو بچے ہیں سنگ سمیٹ لو‘ نہ دکھانے کا مطالبہ
stories.summary:
انڈین وزارتِ اطلاعات و نشریات نے سٹریمنگ پلیٹ فارم نیٹ فلکس سے مطالبہ کیا ہے کہ پاکستان کی پہلی اوریجنل سیریز ’جو بچے ہیں سنگ سمیٹ لو‘ کو انڈیا میں نشر نہ کیا جائے۔ یہ سیریز چار دسمبر 2026 کو دنیا بھر کے 191 ممالک میں ریلیز ہونی ہے۔

سرکاری ذرائع کے مطابق یہ ہدایت انڈین وزارت کو اس سیریز کی ممکنہ ریلیز کے خلاف متعدد شکایات ملنے کے بعد جاری کی گئی۔ انڈین حکام نے نیٹ فلکس کو کہا ہے کہ وہ آٹھ مئی 2025 کو جاری کی گئی ایڈوائزری پر عمل کرے تاکہ پاکستانی مواد انڈیا میں دستیاب نہ ہو سکے۔

اس سے قبل آل انڈیا سینے ورکرز ایسوسی ایشن (AICWA) نے انڈین وزیراعظم نریندر مودی کو خط لکھ کر اس سیریز کی ریلیز روکنے اور پاکستانی ڈراموں، فلموں اور فنکاروں پر مستقل پابندی عائد کرنے کا مطالبہ کیا تھا۔ اس تنظیم نے اپنے خط میں پاکستان پر دہشت گردی کا الزام بھی عائد کیا۔

پاکستان کے وفاقی وزیر احسن اقبال نے اس صورتحال پر ردعمل دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ کھیلوں، پانی کے بعد اب فن اور ثقافت کو ہتھیار بنایا جا رہا ہے۔ دوسری جانب اس سیریز کی مصنفہ فرحت اشتیاق، خالق مومنہ درید اور کاسٹ میں شامل فنکاروں نے اس عالمی منصوبے پر خوشی کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے امید ظاہر کی ہے کہ اس سے پاکستانی ڈراموں کے لیے عالمی دروازے کھلیں گے۔

stories.title: US Proposes New Tariffs on Indian Imports Linked to Trade Deal
stories.summary:
The United States administration has put forward a proposal for a 25% tariff rate on Indian goods to address what Washington characterizes as excess industrial capacity, with a provision to reduce the levy to 17% contingent upon the successful conclusion of a long-delayed trade agreement. This proposed 17% rate sits slightly below the figures planned for several other competing economies, potentially granting Indian exporters a relative commercial advantage.

While nations such as Bangladesh, Cambodia, Indonesia, and Vietnam face alternative proposed structures, the trade discussions between New Delhi and Washington have encountered multiple complications since starting in February 2025. These hurdles include a new US statute enabling tariffs of up to 100% due to India's purchases of Russian oil, alongside diplomatic friction stemming from a US military strike off Oman that resulted in the deaths of three Indian seafarers and disagreements regarding a regional ceasefire.

Despite these rocky bilateral relations, the United States remains India's largest export market, with total goods exports expanding by 14.5% to reach $59.5 billion between April and October.
